q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Agent → Purpose): "Several measures" (A) subject है, "Have been introduced" (B) passive verb है, "By the government" (C) कर्ता बताता है और "To control inflation" (D) उद्देश्य बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "Several measures have been introduced by the government to control inflation", इसलिए सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: 1. Stress and anxiety can negatively affect a person's well-being.
2. Mental health is as important as physical health.
3. Engaging in mindfulness, physical exercise and positive social interactions can help in this.
4. Therefore, taking care of mental health should be a priority for everyone.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Importance → Conclusion → Problem → Solution): 2: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य शारीरिक स्वास्थ्य जितना ही ज़रूरी है → 4: इसलिए इसकी देखभाल प्राथमिकता होनी चाहिए → 1: तनाव और चिंता सेहत पर बुरा असर डालते हैं → 3: mindfulness, कसरत और मेलजोल मदद करते हैं। सही क्रम 2-4-1-3।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 15 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. Matches are broadcast online for fans.
2. The Indian Chess Federation organises national championships.
3. Winners often qualify for global tournaments.
4. Young talents compete for prestigious titles.
q.e: Start directly with the highest organizational body acting as the core subject (2). Follow heavily with the main action of who is actively competing (4). Then detail the thrilling spectator experience (1), finishing with the grand ultimate outcome for the winners (3).

pp: S1. As I was yesterday taking the air with my friend Sir Roger, we were met by a fresh-coloured ruddy young man who rid by us full speed, with a couple of servants behind him.
A. She is a very good lady, says my friend, but took so much care of her son's health that she has made him good for nothing.
B. He was let loose among the woods as soon as he was able to ride on horseback or to carry a gun upon his shoulder.
C. She quickly found that reading was bad for his eyes and that writing made his headache.

D. Upon my inquiry who he was, Sir Roger told me that he was a young gentleman of a considerable estate who had been educated by a tender mother that lived not many miles from the place where we were.

S2. To be brief, I found, by my friend's account of him, that he had got a great stock of health, but nothing else; and that if it were a man's business only to live, there would not be a more accomplished young fellow in the whole country.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Inquiry & Elaboration): S1 में एक नौजवान (young man) से मुलाक़ात का ज़िक्र है। D में लेखक पूछता है कि वह कौन है ("Upon my inquiry who he was"), और सर रोजर उसकी "tender mother" (माँ) के बारे में बताते हैं। A में उसी माँ ("She") के ज़्यादा लाड़-प्यार की बात है (D-A लिंक)। C में माँ के बहाने (पढ़ाई से सिरदर्द) बताए गए हैं। B बताता है कि पढ़ाई की जगह वह क्या करता था (woods में आज़ाद घूमना), जो S2 के निष्कर्ष ("great stock of health, but nothing else") से जुड़ता है।

pp: 1. This involves careful budgeting and debt management.
2. Financial literacy is essential for individual well-being.
3. It empowers people to make informed decisions about money.
4. Education plays a vital role in improving financial literacy rates.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun Link): 2 "Financial literacy" का परिचय देता है। 3 "It" कहकर बताता है कि यह लोगों को क्या करने में सशक्त (empower) बनाता है (2-3 लिंक)। 1 "This involves" कहकर बताता है कि इस निर्णय लेने में क्या-क्या शामिल है। 4 निष्कर्ष देता है कि शिक्षा की इसमें क्या भूमिका है।

pp: 1. They are responsible for pollinating many plants.
2. Bees are essential for biodiversity and food production.
3. However, their population has been steadily declining.
4. The major reasons for this are habitat loss and pesticides.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Importance → Role → Problem → Causes): 2: मधुमक्खियाँ जैव विविधता और खाद्य उत्पादन के लिए ज़रूरी हैं → 1: वे कई पौधों का परागण करती हैं → 3: "However" से उनकी आबादी घट रही है → 4: मुख्य कारण आवास की हानि और कीटनाशक हैं। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: A: To protect endangered species
B: Wildlife sanctuaries
C: Have been established
D: Across the country
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Purpose → Scope): "Wildlife sanctuaries" (B) subject है, "Have been established" (C) passive verb phrase है, "To protect endangered species" (A) उद्देश्य बताता है और "Across the country" (D) दायरा बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "Wildlife sanctuaries have been established to protect endangered species across the country", इसलिए सही क्रम BCAD।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. This creates challenges for mental well-being.
B. Urban life offers convenience and opportunities.
C. However, it also increases isolation.
D. Community bonds are weaker in cities.
q.e: Sentence B introduces the positive side of urban life. C contrasts this directly ("However, it also increases isolation"). D expands on the isolation by explaining the cause (Community bonds are weaker). A concludes by stating the final impact (challenges for mental well-being).

pp: (1) He entered the complete address of where he was going into the search bar.
(2) The navigation system then directed him with turn-by-turn instructions while he drove.
(3) Having considered the alternatives, he chose the one with the shortest estimated duration.
(4) He turned on his GPS and waited for the device to gain a signal from the satellites.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (GPS usage steps): 4: GPS चालू कर signal का इंतज़ार किया → 1: गंतव्य का पता डाला → 3: सबसे छोटा रास्ता सोचकर चुना → 2: navigation system ने गाड़ी चलाते समय निर्देश दिए। सही क्रम 4-1-3-2।

t: S2. Although it was still February, winter was on its last legs, signs of which he had for the first time in years begun to notice.
pp: S1. The two went to their business.
A. He seated himself at the matchmaker's side but facing him, attempting by an act of will to suppress the unpleasant tickle in his throat.
B. As he flipped through them, a gesture and sound that physically hurt Leo, the student pretended not to see and gazed steadfastly out the window.
C. Salzman eagerly unstrapped his portfolio and removed a loose rubber band from a thin packet of much-handled cards.
D. Leo had led Salzman to the only clear place in the room, a table near a window that overlooked the lamp-lit city.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Positioning & Action Flow): S1 काम (business) शुरू होने की बात करता है। D दोनों की जगह तय करता है (table near window)। A बताता है कि लियो (Leo) खुद बैठ गया (seated himself)। C में सेल्समैन (Salzman) अपना काम शुरू करता है और 'cards' (कार्ड्स) निकालता है। B में वह उन कार्ड्स को पलटता है (flipped through them) और लियो खिड़की के बाहर (out the window) देखता है , जो S2 के बाहर के मौसम (winter) से जुड़ता है।

pp: P. The group of scientists was looking for a new planet outside of our solar system, known as an exoplanet.
Q. They observed the far-off star using a powerful telescope in search of a telltale dimming of its brightness.
R. They found a new planet, establishing its existence through a series of follow-up observations.
S. This slight dimming would indicate a planet passing in front of the star.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Scientific Discovery Process): P एक्सोप्लैनेट ढूँढने के लक्ष्य को बताता है। Q बताता है कि उन्होंने एक तारे की चमक कम होने ( dimming) को देखा। S बताता है कि "This slight dimming" (यह कम चमक) एक ग्रह के गुजरने का इशारा है (Q-S पक्का जोड़ा)। R आख़िरी में बताता है कि उन्होंने नया ग्रह खोज लिया (found a new planet)।

pp: 1. This, in turn, can increase economic activity and contribute to overall development.
2. The construction of new roads and bridges is a critical component of a nation's infrastructure development.
3. An efficient transportation network reduces travel time and lowers logistical costs for both businesses and consumers.
4. Such projects connect different regions, allowing for the faster movement of goods and people.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic-Demonstrative Link): 2 "construction of new roads and bridges" का परिचय देता है। 4 "Such projects" कहकर उन्हीं सड़कों-पुलों की बात करता है (2-4 का पक्का जोड़ा)। 3 कनेक्टिविटी का सीधा फायदा (travel time कम होना) बताता है। 1 "This, in turn" के साथ अंतिम आर्थिक लाभ (economic activity बढ़ना) बताता है।

pp: 1. This can lead to environmental degradation.
2. Rapid industrialization often brings economic growth.
3. However, it frequently comes at a significant cost to the environment.
4. Strict regulations are needed to mitigate these negative impacts.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Claim-Contrast-Effect-Solution): 2 मुख्य दावा है कि इंडस्ट्रियलाइज़ेशन (औद्योगिकीकरण) से आर्थिक विकास होता है। 3 "However" के साथ बताता है कि इसकी कीमत पर्यावरण को चुकानी पड़ती है (2-3 लिंक)। 1 "This" (पर्यावरण की कीमत) का असर बताता है कि पर्यावरण का पतन (degradation) होता है। 4 "mitigate these negative impacts" के लिए सख्त नियमों (regulations) की माँग करता है।

pp: A: The headmaster
B: For his punctuality
C: Praised
D: The student
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Reason): "The headmaster" (A) subject है, "Praised" (C) verb है, "The student" (D) object है और "For his punctuality" (B) कारण बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The headmaster praised the student for his punctuality", इसलिए सही क्रम ACDB।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 15 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. Trials are conducted before full deployment.
2. Modern equipment allows faster and safer train operations.
3. The Ministry of Railways is upgrading signalling systems.
4. The upgrades will improve punctuality across the network.
q.e: Sentence (3) actively introduces the primary subject (Ministry upgrades). Sentence (2) perfectly elaborates on how this modern equipment heavily functions. Sentence (1) injects the highly cautious deployment process, and Sentence (4) triumphantly states the absolute final result.

pp: 1. It is because many young people are struggling with stress and anxiety nowadays.
2. Experts suggest that physical exercise and a balanced diet can help alleviate these issues.
3. Mental health has become an important topic of discussion in recent years.
4. The pressure to succeed in academics and career plays a significant role in this struggle.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic → Reason → Specific cause → Solution): 3: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य एक अहम विषय बन गया है → 1: क्योंकि कई युवा तनाव और चिंता से जूझ रहे हैं → 4: पढ़ाई और करियर का दबाव इस संघर्ष में भूमिका निभाता है → 2: विशेषज्ञ कसरत और संतुलित आहार सुझाते हैं। सही क्रम 3-1-4-2।

pp: 1. This requires strong leadership and teamwork.
2. Organizational change is often met with resistance.
3. Effective communication strategies are essential for a smooth transition.
4. It is a necessary process for growth and adaptation.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Problem-Necessity-Solution): 2 "Organizational change" और उसके विरोध की बात करता है। 4 "It" का उपयोग करके बताता है कि विरोध के बावजूद यह आवश्यक है (2-4 लिंक)। 3 बताता है कि इस बदलाव को सुचारू बनाने के लिए क्या चाहिए। 1 बताता है कि इस काम ("This") के लिए कुशल नेतृत्व (leadership) की आवश्यकता है।

pp: S1. Thereupon Saidjah tore a piece off his much-worn blue turban and gave it to Adinda to keep as a pledge and then left her and Badoer.
A. He had never before seen the like.
B. He walked many days, passing through Rankas-Belong, not yet capital of Lebak, through Warong-Goonoong, the home of the Assistant Resident, and the next day he came to Pamarangand.
C. He remained there a day, because he was tired, but in the coolness of the night he went his way, and the following day arrived at Tangerang.
D. The day after, he came to Serang and was astonished at the magnificence and size of the place, and the number of tiled stone houses.
S2. There he bathed in the river and rested at the home of an acquaintance of his father’s.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Chronological Journey): S1 में Saidjah के जाने (left) की बात है। B में उसकी पैदल यात्रा ("walked many days") शुरू होती है। D में "The day after" (उसके अगले दिन) वह Serang पहुँचता है और वहाँ की भव्यता देखकर हैरान (astonished) रह जाता है। A में बताता है कि उसने ऐसा पहले कभी नहीं देखा था ("never before seen the like") (D-A लिंक)। C में वह आगे बढ़कर Tangerang पहुँचता है, और S2 में "There" (वहाँ) नहाकर आराम करता है।

pp: 1. Time management helps improve productivity.
P: Procrastination leads to wasted hours.
Q: Creating a schedule prevents delays.
R: It gives direction and reduces stress.
S: Staying disciplined is the key.
6. Success often depends on how we manage time.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Benefit → Tool → Problem → Solution): Sentence 1 समय प्रबंधन की भूमिका बताता है। R इसके लाभ (दिशा, कम तनाव) समझाता है। Q व्यावहारिक साधन (schedule बनाना) देता है। P नकारात्मक विरोधाभास (टालमटोल से घंटे बर्बाद) लाता है। S व्यवहारिक समाधान (अनुशासन) बताता है। सही क्रम RQPS।

pp: P: the guests
Q: with bouquets
R: were warmly
S: greeted
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही क्रम PRSQ है: "The guests were warmly greeted with bouquets." कर्ता, क्रिया, पूरक और सहायक अंश इसी क्रम में रखने पर वाक्य व्याकरण और अर्थ दोनों से सुसंगत बनता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 11 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. Chronic pollution in
P. respiratory health and
Q. major cities affects
R. chronic diseases globally
S. contributes to rising rates of
6. among the urban population.
q.e: The subject fragment (1) needs completion: "Chronic pollution in" matches with (Q) "major cities affects". This active verb governs the direct object (P) "respiratory health and". The conjunction leads to the secondary verb (S) "contributes to rising rates of", followed by (R) "chronic diseases globally".

pp: P. Its expansive plains and rich soil, perfect for farming and grazing, drew them in.
Q. A surge of settlers started to go west over the American continent in the 19th century.
R. Their difficult voyage was motivated by the prospect of a fresh life and inexpensive land.
S. This large-scale migration permanently altered the region's culture and geography.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Historical Event to Impact): Q अमेरिका में लोगों के पश्चिम (west) की ओर जाने (migration) की शुरुआत बताता है। R "Their" के साथ इन 'settlers' की वजह बताता है (Q-R लिंक)। P "Its" के साथ बताता है कि किस चीज़ (plains and rich soil) ने उन्हें आकर्षित किया। S "This large-scale migration" के अंतिम बड़े असर (altered culture and geography) का निष्कर्ष देता है।

pp: 1. Consequently, new forms of entertainment emerged.
2. The advent of television transformed leisure activities.
3. People spent more time at home, watching programs.
4. It significantly impacted social interaction patterns.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause-Action-Effect): 2 टीवी के आने (advent of television) की बात करता है। 3 बताता है कि टीवी आने से लोगों ने क्या किया (घर पर ज़्यादा समय बिताया) (2-3 लिंक)। 4 बताता है कि "It" (इस बदलाव) का सामाजिक मेलजोल पर क्या असर पड़ा। 1 "Consequently" (नतीजतन) के साथ अंत में आएगा।

pp: 1. Marie Curie was a pioneer in radioactivity research.
2. These were initially used in the treatment of cancer.
3. She discovered radium and polonium.
4. Unfortunately, years of exposure to radioactive material led to her untimely demise.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduction → Discovery → Use → Consequence): 1: Marie Curie radioactivity शोध की अग्रणी थीं → 3: उन्होंने radium और polonium खोजे → 2: शुरू में इनका उपयोग कैंसर के इलाज में हुआ → 4: दुर्भाग्य से इनके संपर्क से उनकी मृत्यु हुई। सही क्रम 1-3-2-4।

pp: 1. Art is a reflection of society.
P: It communicates emotions beyond words.
Q: From cave paintings to modern murals, art evolves.
R: Artists express views on culture, politics, and identity.
S: It also raises awareness on social issues.
6. Hence, art holds immense power in society.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (History → Function → Content → Impact): Sentence 1 कला को समाज का प्रतिबिंब बताता है। Q गुफा चित्रों से आधुनिक भित्तिचित्रों तक कला का ऐतिहासिक सफ़र दिखाता है। P बताता है कि कला भावनाएँ कैसे व्यक्त करती है। R बताता है कि कलाकार क्या व्यक्त करते हैं (संस्कृति, राजनीति, पहचान)। S सामाजिक जागरूकता का आयाम जोड़ता है, जो sentence 6 तक पहुँचाता है। सही क्रम QPRS।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: P: This, in turn, resulted in a new appreciation for the simple beauty of nature.
Q: Agroup of poets in the 19th century began to write about the human experience in a raw, emotional style.
R: Their work, which would later be called Romanticism, moved away from formal, structured verse.
S: They sought to capture the feeling of awe and wonder inspired by mountains and forests.
q.e: Sentence (Q) introduces the specific foundational actors ("A group of poets"). Sentence (R) formally names this new movement ("Romanticism"). Sentence (S) describes their exact profound goal regarding awe, and Sentence (P) concludes with the massive resulting cultural shift regarding nature.

pp: A. Anutritious diet favours growth.
B. Nutrition is, therefore, the most important external factor for growth.
C. In fact, at every stage, the body needs a basic level of nutrients for its sustenance.
D. Growth requires multiplication of cells or enlargement of cells, which depends on an adequate supply of nutrients.
q.e: Sentence A introduces the main topic of nutritious diet and growth. Sentence D elaborates on how growth occurs through cell multiplication depending on nutrients. Sentence C adds a supporting fact about the body's constant need for nutrients. Sentence B concludes the paragraph by summarizing nutrition as the key factor.

pp: S1. While speaking he gradually held the watch nearer till it almost touched the child's pale face, which plainly showed the struggle that was going on in his soul between covetousness and respect for hospitality.
A. Meanwhile, the watch was slowly swaying and turning, sometimes brushing against his cheek.
B. The face was light blue; the cases newly burnished.
C. Finally, his right hand was gradually stretched toward it; the ends of his fingers touched it; then its whole weight was in his hand, the adjutant still keeping hold of the chain.
D. His breast swelled with emotion; he seemed about to suffocate. S2. In the sunlight it seemed to be all on fire.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Emotional Reaction & Visual Detail): S1 बच्चे के चेहरे के पास घड़ी (watch) लाने की बात करता है। D बच्चे की गहरी भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया (emotion/suffocate) को दिखाता है। A घड़ी के उसके गाल से टकराने (brushing against his cheek) की निरंतर क्रिया (Meanwhile) को बताता है। C में बच्चा अंततः ("Finally") घड़ी को अपने हाथ में ले लेता है। B घड़ी के चेहरे (light blue face/cases) का वर्णन करता है, जो S2 ("In the sunlight it seemed to be all on fire") से जुड़ता है।

pp: 1. They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace.
2. Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge.
3. As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before.
4. Technology has revolutionized education.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General → Specific → Consequence): 4: तकनीक ने शिक्षा में क्रांति ला दी → 2: online platforms वैश्विक ज्ञान तक पहुँच देते हैं → 1: वे अपनी गति से सीखने की लचीलापन भी देते हैं → 3: नतीजतन छात्रों के पास पहले से ज़्यादा अवसर हैं। सही क्रम 4-2-1-3।

pp: 1. Therefore, fostering creativity is vital for innovation.
2. Creativity is often misunderstood as an innate talent.
3. However, it is a skill that can be developed and nurtured.
4. It involves imagination, critical thinking, and problem-solving.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Misconception & Correction): 2 "Creativity" को लेकर एक ग़लतफ़हमी (misunderstood) बताता है। 3 "However" के साथ उस ग़लतफ़हमी को दूर करता है कि यह एक 'skill' है (2-3 पक्का जोड़ा)। 4 "It involves" के साथ इस स्किल के हिस्से बताता है। 1 "Therefore" के साथ निष्कर्ष निकालता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 12 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. Cybersecurity measures were strengthened.
B. Amajor data breach occurred.
C. User trust was restored.
D. Vulnerabilities were identified.
q.e: The logical sequence demands cause and effect. A breach occurred first (B). This disastrous event caused vulnerabilities to be deeply identified (D). Subsequently, measures were heavily strengthened (A), which finally resulted in restoring user trust (C).

pp: 1. The United Nations was formed after the Second World War.
P: It was established to prevent future global conflicts.
Q: Over the decades, it has expanded its roles.
R: Now it addresses issues like climate change and human rights.
S: Its peacekeeping missions have played a vital role in conflict zones.
6. Despite criticisms, the UN remains a key international body.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Chronological: Founding → Purpose → Expansion → Examples): Sentence 1 संयुक्त राष्ट्र के गठन का परिचय देता है। P मूल उद्देश्य (भावी वैश्विक संघर्ष रोकना) बताता है। Q बताता है कि समय के साथ उसकी भूमिकाएँ कैसे बढ़ीं। R आधुनिक उदाहरण (जलवायु परिवर्तन, मानवाधिकार) देता है। S शांति स्थापना की भूमिका जोड़ता है। सही क्रम PQRS।

pp: 1. The importance of physical fitness cannot be overstated in today's fast-paced world.
2. It even contributes to better mental health by lowering stress levels.
3. It also reduces the risk of chronic illnesses such as heart disease and diabetes.
4. Regular exercise helps to maintain a healthy body and boosts energy levels.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Main statement → Primary benefit → Additional → Broader): 1: शारीरिक फ़िटनेस का महत्व है → 4: नियमित कसरत शरीर स्वस्थ रखती है → 3: यह पुरानी बीमारियों का ख़तरा भी घटाती है → 2: यह तनाव घटाकर मानसिक सेहत भी सुधारती है। सही क्रम 1-4-3-2।

pp: S1. But the voice of Sofia did not change as she said these words.
A. Even this evening, passed alone with this strange girl, seemed to him something predestined and long awaited.
B. Her face wore such a frank expression, her tone was so simple, so pure, so convinced, that Roberto felt no surprise at hearing her.
C. When they separated they gazed directly into each other's faces, as though they wished to be sure of recognizing each other.
D. Nothing now surprised him; everything seemed natural, to be expected.
S2. Sofia held out her hand, Roberto took it and bowed over it; a portière fell heavily behind him.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Voice to Expression to Reaction): S1 सोफिया (Sofia) की स्थिर आवाज़ के बारे में बताता है। B उसके चेहरे के भाव (frank expression) के कारण रॉबर्टो (Roberto) के हैरान न होने (no surprise) की बात करता है (S1-B लिंक)। D इस 'हैरान न होने' की बात को आगे बढ़ाता है ("Nothing now surprised him"). A उसके इस शाम को पूर्व-निश्चित (predestined) मानने की बात करता है। C उनके अलग होते (separated) समय एक-दूसरे को देखने की बात करता है, जो S2 की विदाई (held out hand) से सीधे जुड़ता है।

t: Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:
pp: A. The headlines captured the scandal's magnitude.
B. He had denied the allegations for weeks.
C. Yet, photos surfaced, contradicting his claims.
D. Public opinion quickly turned against him.
q.e: Sentence B introduces the situation (denying allegations). Sentence C provides the turning point (photos surfaced). Sentence A describes the immediate media reaction (headlines captured magnitude). Sentence D concludes with the final result (public opinion turned). Thus, BCAD is the logical sequence.

pp: 1. Therefore, emotional intelligence is highly valued in leadership.
2. Emotional intelligence (EQ) is distinct from IQ.
3. It involves understanding and managing one's own emotions.
4. It also includes perceiving and influencing others' emotions.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Definition & Conclusion): 2 EQ का परिचय देता है। 3 "It" (EQ) का पहला हिस्सा बताता है। 4 "It also includes" कहकर दूसरा हिस्सा बताता है (3-4 का पक्का जोड़ा)। 1 "Therefore" (इसलिए) के साथ निष्कर्ष निकालता है, अतः यह अंत में आएगा।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. These apps offer tools for meditation, mood tracking, and virtual therapy sessions.
B. Mental health apps have seen explosive growth in recent years.
C. They are making professional mental health support more accessible and affordable.
D. However, experts caution that apps cannot fully replace human therapists in serious cases.
q.e: Sentence (B) acts as the perfect foundational topic sentence, robustly introducing "Mental health apps". Sentence (A) strictly elaborates on exactly what these specific apps offer. Sentence (C) heavily details the massive positive results, while Sentence (D) wisely provides a highly balancing cautionary conclusion.

pp: 1. This leads to a decline in their overall well-being.
2. Many people today suffer from excessive stress.
3. Consequently, coping mechanisms become essential for a balanced life.
4. It often manifests as physical and mental exhaustion.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Problem-Symptom-Effect-Solution): 2 में मुख्य समस्या (stress) बताई गई है। 4 में "It" (stress) के लक्षण (exhaustion) बताए गए हैं (2-4 लिंक)। 1 में "This leads to" कहकर इसका बुरा असर (decline in well-being) बताया गया है। 3 में "Consequently" (नतीजतन) के साथ इसका समाधान (coping mechanisms) दिया गया है।

pp: A: Water the plants
B: Every morning
C: Before breakfast
D: We
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Frequency → Time): "We" (D) subject है, "Water the plants" (A) verb phrase और object है, "Every morning" (B) आवृत्ति बताता है और "Before breakfast" (C) समय को और सटीक करता है। वाक्य बनता है: "We water the plants every morning before breakfast", इसलिए सही क्रम DABC।

pp: (1) He carefully entered the recipient's email, typed in a subject line, and composed a detailed message.
(2) Having entered, he clicked on the 'Compose' button to start writing a new email.
(3) Having gone through the content, he clicked the 'Send' button to send the email successfully.
(4) He logged into his email account using his username and a safe password.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Email sending steps): 4: पहले email account में login किया → 2: "Compose" पर क्लिक किया → 1: प्राप्तकर्ता का email डालकर संदेश लिखा → 3: समीक्षा के बाद "Send" क्लिक किया। सही क्रम 4-2-1-3।

pp: 1. Ocean acidification is a consequence of increased CO2 emissions.
2. This leads to a decline in marine biodiversity.
3. Coral reefs are particularly vulnerable to acidification.
4. Urgent action is required to reduce emissions and mitigate damage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause-Effect-Conclusion): 1 महासागर के अम्लीकरण (ocean acidification) को बताता है। 3 बताता है कि इसका सबसे ज़्यादा असर 'Coral reefs' पर पड़ता है (1-3 लिंक)। 2 "This leads to" कहकर इसका अंतिम परिणाम (जैव विविधता में कमी) बताता है। 4 तत्काल कार्रवाई (Urgent action) की मांग करके निष्कर्ष निकालता है।

pp: (1) He allowed the mixture to steep for several minutes in order to create a strong, flavorful brew.
(2) He filled the electric kettle with clean water carefully and put it safely on the stove.
(3) Once the water had boiled, he poured measured quantities of tea leaves and sugar into it.
(4) And so, he poured the boiling tea into a scrubbed ceramic mug and served it hot.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Tea-making steps): 2: केतली में पानी भरा → 3: उबलने पर चायपत्ती और चीनी डाली → 1: उसे कुछ मिनट भीगने दिया → 4: फिर मग में डालकर परोसा। सही क्रम 2-3-1-4।

t: Choose the option that shows the correctly arranged sentence from the below-given jumbled parts: "The Ganges / is considered / sacred / by Hindus / in India"
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 10 Sep 2026, Shift-3]
o: The Ganges is considered sacred by Hindus in India
By Hindus the Ganges is considered sacred in India
In India Hindus is considered sacred the Ganges
Hindus in India is considered sacred the Ganges
q.e: The parts naturally follow standard Subject-Verb-Object- Adjunct word order. "The Ganges" (Subject) "is considered sacred" (Verb phrase + complement) "by Hindus" (Agent) "in India" (Location adjunct), forming a perfectly structured and meaningful sentence.

pp: S1. There was plenty of fish in the creek, fresh-water bream, cod, cat-fish, and tailers.
A. Andy would fish for three hours at a stretch if encouraged by a 'nibble' or a 'bite' now and then say once in twenty minutes.
B. The party were fond of fish, and Andy and Dave of fishing.

C. However, the creek was low, just a chain of muddy water-holes, from the hole with a few bucketfuls in it to the sizable pool with an average depth of six or seven feet, and they could get fish by baling out the smaller holes or muddying up the water in the larger ones till the fish rose to the surface.
D. The butcher was always willing to give meat in exchange for fish when they caught more than they could eat; but now it was winter, and these fish wouldn't bite.
S2. There was the cat-fish, with spikes growing out of the sides of its head, and if you got pricked you'd know it, as Dave said.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Context-Problem-Attempt-Alternative): S1 बताता है कि नदी में बहुत मछली थी। B बताता है कि समूह (party) को मछली खाना और एंडी-डेव (Andy, Dave) को पकड़ना पसंद था (S1-B लिंक)। D बताता है कि वे ज़्यादा मछली को गोश्त (meat) से बदल लेते थे, पर अब सर्दियां थीं और मछली काँटा नहीं पकड़ रही थी (wouldn't bite)। A बताता है कि इसके बावजूद एंडी (Andy) 3 घंटे तक कोशिश करता था। C "However" के साथ मछली पकड़ने का दूसरा तरीका (baling out holes) बताता है जिससे S2 का कैट-फिश (cat-fish) का वर्णन जुड़ता है।

pp: P. The finance minister presents the budget in Parliament
Q. The Ministry of Finance collects estimates from various ministries
R. The budget is passed by both houses of Parliament
S. The Cabinet approves the final draft of the budget
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Chronological Budget Process): प्रक्रिया मंत्रालयों से अनुमान इकट्ठा करने से शुरू होती है (Q)। फिर Cabinet अंतिम मसौदा मंज़ूर करती है (S)। उसके बाद वित्त मंत्री उसे औपचारिक रूप से संसद में पेश करता है (P)। अंत में दोनों सदन वोट देकर उसे क़ानून बनाते हैं (R)। यह भारत में बजट तैयार करने की मानक संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया है। सही क्रम Q-S-P-R।

t: Given below are four jumbled sentences.Select the option that gives their correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
pp: P. The caterpillar then stops feeding, attaches itself to a branch, and forms a protective chrysalis.
Q. The egg hatches into a small caterpillar that feeds voraciously on leaves and grows rapidly in size.
R. Abutterfly starts its life as a tiny egg that is laid on the surface of a leaf.
S. Afully developed butterfly eventually pushes out of the chrysalis and spreads its wings for the first time.
q.e: The paragraph describes the biological life cycle of a butterfly. It begins with the egg stage (R), followed by the hatching and growth of the caterpillar (Q). Next, the caterpillar forms a chrysalis (P), and finally, the adult butterfly emerges (S).

pp: P: First, seed samples are collected from genetically diverse parent lines.
Q: These plants are evaluated under multi-location trials for performance.
R: The seeds are then cultivated under controlled experimental fields.
S: Traits like drought resistance and yield are measured and documented.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Key के अनुसार क्रम P→Q→R→S है। तार्किक प्रक्रिया P (बीज इकट्ठा) → R (खेत में उगाना) → Q (पौधों का मूल्यांकन) → S (गुण मापना) बनती है, पर यह दिए विकल्पों में नहीं है; यह प्रश्न SSC ने Wrong घोषित किया था, इसलिए स्रोत की key ही दी गई है।

pp: P. A large-scale migration was triggered in 1848 by the discovery of gold in California.
Q. Prospectors from all over the world were drawn to the promise of immediate fortune.
R. Few of the "Forty-Niners" did become wealthy.
S. Towns and communities in the American West proliferated as a result of this migration.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Event-Reaction-Effect-Conclusion): P 1848 में कैलिफ़ोर्निया में सोना (gold) मिलने की मुख्य घटना बताता है। Q बताता है कि इस वजह से पूरी दुनिया से लोग (Prospectors) वहां खिंचे चले आए (P-Q लिंक)। S "as a result of this migration" के साथ इसका असर बताता है कि वहां शहर (Towns) बस गए। R एक विरोधाभास वाला निष्कर्ष देता है कि इतने लोगों में से कुछ ही अमीर बन पाए (Few became wealthy)।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: 1. Coordinated raids lead to arrests.
2. Intelligence is gathered from multiple states.
3. Confiscated animal parts are handed to the forest authorities.
4. The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau investigates poaching networks.
q.e: Sentence 4 sets the premise by introducing the investigating agency. Sentence 2 details the first operational step (gathering intelligence). Sentence 1 acts as the resulting action (coordinated raids and arrests). Finally, Sentence 3 concludes with the handling of the confiscated evidence.

pp: 1. This process, a cornerstone of evolution, ensures that only individuals best suited to their environment survive to reproduce.
2. The diversity of life on Earth is the result of a gradual process of change over vast spans of time.
3. This leads to the gradual accumulation of favorable traits within a population.
4. It begins with inherited variation among individuals, where some possess characteristics that give them an advantage over others.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Process Flow Indicator): 2 पृथ्वी पर जीवन की विविधता और धीमी प्रक्रिया का परिचय देता है। 4 बताता है कि यह प्रक्रिया कैसे शुरू होती है ("It begins with...") (2-4 लिंक)। 3 इसका परिणाम ("This leads to...") बताता है। 1 इस पूरी प्रक्रिया का नाम (evolution) और महत्व बताता है।

pp: A: The winner
B: declared
C: Was
D: Yesterday
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Time): "The winner" (A) subject है, "Was declared" (C + B) passive verb phrase है और "Yesterday" (D) अंत में समय बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The winner was declared yesterday", इसलिए सही क्रम ACBD।

pp: S1. I'm doing fine, except I've got no appetite.
A. I keep hearing: "Goodness, you look awful!"
B. The atmosphere is stifling, sluggish, leaden.
C. My nerves often get the better of me, especially on Sundays; that is when I really feel miserable.
D. I must admit they're doing their best to keep me in condition: they're plying me with dextrose, cod-liver oil, brewer's yeast and calcium.
S2. Outside, you don't hear a single bird, and a deathly, oppressive silence hangs over the house and clings to me as if it were going to drag me into the deepest regions of the underworld.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Physical to Mental to Environmental state): S1 स्पीकर की शारीरिक अवस्था (no appetite) बताता है। D बताता है कि कैसे लोग उसे शारीरिक रूप से ठीक रखने (keep in condition) की कोशिश कर रहे हैं (दवाइयाँ देकर)। A बताता है कि इसके बावजूद लोग कहते हैं कि वह बीमार ("awful") दिख रहा है। C उसकी मानसिक अवस्था (nerves/miserable) पर आता है। B घर के अंदर के दमघोंटू माहौल (stifling atmosphere) का वर्णन करता है, जो S2 के बाहर के सन्नाटे (deathly silence) से मेल खाता है।

pp: 1. The candidate was asked to provide valid identification.
2. Her fingerprints were scanned and verified against the database.
3. She was escorted to the interview room after verification.
4. The security desk logged her entry into the visitor register.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Security procedure): 1: उम्मीदवार से वैध पहचान माँगी गई → 4: security desk ने उसकी प्रविष्टि दर्ज की → 2: उँगलियों के निशान स्कैन कर डेटाबेस से मिलाए गए → 3: उसे interview room तक ले जाया गया। सही क्रम 1-4-2-3।

t: Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?
pp: 1. He introduced his theory of evolution in the book "On the Origin of Species"
2. Charles Darwin was a naturalist who studied plants and animals.
3. He traveled to the Galápagos Islands, where he observed unique species.
4. His theory changed the way scientists understood the development of life.
q.e: Sentence 2 introduces Charles Darwin and his profession. Sentence 3 logically follows by mentioning his voyage and observations. Sentence 1 details the publication of his theory resulting from those observations, and Sentence 4 concludes with the impact of his work.

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: 1. Several skill development centres have opened across Uttar Pradesh.
2. These centres offer training in IT, sewing, and carpentry.
3. The government aims to reduce unemployment through this scheme.
4. Young people enrol eagerly to learn practical skills.
q.e: Sentence 1 introduces the opening of the centres. Sentence 2 directly builds upon this by defining what "These centres" offer. Sentence 4 showcases the immediate public reaction (enrolment). Sentence 3 concludes by summarizing the broader governmental goal of the entire initiative.

pp: 1. This makes them ideal for tasks like image recognition, natural language processing, and medical diagnostics.
2. Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that focuses on the creation of algorithms that can learn from data without explicit programming.
3. The algorithm improves its performance by analyzing vast amounts of input data and identifying underlying patterns.
4. Instead of being given a set of rules, a machine learning model is trained on examples.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General to Specific): 2 "Machine learning" की परिभाषा से शुरू होता है। 4 बताता है कि इसमें rules की बजाय examples पर training दी जाती है (2-4 लिंक)। 3 बताता है कि यह algorithm डेटा का विश्लेषण करके कैसे सीखता है। 1 बताता है कि यही खूबी ("This") उन्हें व्यावहारिक कार्यों के लिए आदर्श बनाती है।

pp: 1. The Earth's climate has changed over centuries.
P: But current warming is caused by human actions.
Q: Historically, it changed due to natural causes.
R: Burning fossil fuels increases greenhouse gases.
S: Deforestation worsens the problem.
6. This calls for urgent action.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (History → Natural cause → Modern contrast → Human causes): Sentence 1 पृथ्वी की जलवायु के सदियों में बदलने की बात करता है। Q तार्किक रूप से अतीत के बदलावों के प्राकृतिक कारण बताता है। P आधुनिक विरोधाभास लाता है कि मौजूदा गर्मी मानवीय कारणों से है। R पहला मानवीय कारण (जीवाश्म ईंधन जलाना) बताता है। S दूसरा कारण (वनों की कटाई) जोड़ता है, जो sentence 6 के निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचाता है। सही क्रम QPRS।

pp: (1) She put each stack into the washing machine, taking care not to overfill it.
(2) She then chose an appropriate cycle and initiated the washing process.
(3) Depending on the type of fabric, she poured a proper amount of detergent accordingly.
(4) She gathered the laundry from various areas of the house, sorting whites from colored garments.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Laundry steps): 4: कपड़े इकट्ठा कर छाँटे → 1: हर ढेर मशीन में सावधानी से डाला → 3: उचित मात्रा में detergent डाला → 2: cycle चुनकर धुलाई शुरू की। सही क्रम 4-1-3-2।

pp: S1. Twilight was descending like a rain of gray ashes.
A. A minute later Lulu entered like a whirlwind, slamming doors, overturning chairs that she might hurry more.
B. It was the hour in which the Via Toledo becomes dangerous because of the great number of large and small carriages that pass up and down in a continuous stream.
C. Sofia, standing at the window that opened out onto the balcony, was gazing down into the crowded, noisy street.
D. Sofia seemed looking for someone; suddenly a vivid flush passed over her face, she bent her head slightly, then suddenly paled and turned back into the room.
S2. "What are you doing here, Donna Sofia Santangelo? Are you reading?"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: S1 समय बताता है (Twilight)। B इसी घड़ी का विस्तार Via Toledo पर करता है। C में Sofia इस भीड़ भरी सड़क को देख रही है। D में वह किसी को देखती है और भीतर लौट आती है। A में तुरंत कोई (Lulu) भीतर आता है, जिससे S2 में Lulu का सवाल जुड़ता है। सही क्रम BCDA।

pp: P. He spent his days in the lab, carefully scanning samples under a microscope.
Q. Dr. Alistair Finch was an accomplished biologist who specialized in the discovery of new species.
R. His peers would tease him that he looked more upon the microbial world than on the actual one.
S. His greatest find was from a small, ordinary pond deep in the Amazon rainforest.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Character Introduction to Achievement): Q डॉ. फेंच (Dr. Finch) का परिचय देता है। P उनके रोज़ के काम (lab and microscope) के बारे में बताता है (Q-P लिंक)। R उनके साथियों (peers) का मज़ाक उड़ाना बताता है क्योंकि वो माइक्रोस्कोप में ही लगे रहते थे (P-R लिंक)। S उनकी सबसे बड़ी खोज (greatest find) बताकर निष्कर्ष देता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 12 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. true confidence is entirely
B. difficult social settings
C. different from merely pretending
D. to be confident while facing
q.e: Part A provides the subject and main verb ("true confidence is entirely"). It connects logically to the adjective in C ("different from merely pretending"). C connects to D ("to be confident while facing"), which provides the object in B ("difficult social settings").

pp: P: the CEO
Q: informed the team
R: during the meeting
S: about new policy changes
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही क्रम PQSR है: "The CEO informed the team about new policy changes during the meeting." कर्ता, क्रिया, पूरक और सहायक अंश इसी क्रम में रखने पर वाक्य व्याकरण और अर्थ दोनों से सुसंगत बनता है।

pp: 1. The Renaissance marked a revival of classical learning.
2. Artists focused on realism and human emotion.
3. Patronage from wealthy families fueled cultural output.
4. This period reshaped Europe's intellectual landscape.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 1 मुख्य विषय (The Renaissance) introduce करता है। 2 उस युग की एक विशेष कलात्मक विशेषता बताता है। 3 इस सांस्कृतिक उछाल के पीछे का आर्थिक तंत्र समझाता है। 4 उसके व्यापक प्रभाव पर निष्कर्ष देता है। सही क्रम 1-2-3-4।

pp: P. Once it is gazetted in the official register, the bill comes into legal force as an enacted statute.
Q. The bill is then carefully scrutinised clause by clause through structured debates and proposed amendments.
R. Alegislator formally introduces the draft bill in the lower house and outlines its stated objectives.
S. After receiving the required majority in both houses, the bill is forwarded to the President for formal assent.
q.e: The passage describes the standard legislative procedure of passing a law. It begins when a bill is formally introduced (R), followed by scrutiny and debates (Q), presidential assent upon passage (S), and enactment into law upon being officially gazetted (P).

pp: A: By the end of the year
B: Complete
C: The construction company
D: Promised to
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The construction company" (C) subject है, "Promised to" (D) infinitive marker वाला verb phrase है, "Complete" (B) infinitive verb है और "By the end of the year" (A) समय बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The construction company promised to complete by the end of the year", इसलिए सही क्रम CDBA।

pp: 1. The team reviews the project deliverables to ensure quality.
2. A detailed timeline is created for the completion of tasks.
3. The progress is evaluated based on the defined metrics.
4. The project is successfully completed within the defined timeline.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Project Management Lifecycle): 2 सबसे पहले काम की 'timeline' (योजना) बनाई जाती है। 3 फिर काम के दौरान प्रोग्रेस को 'evaluate' (चेक) किया जाता है। 1 काम के अंत में 'quality' के लिए उसे रिव्यु (review) किया जाता है। 4 "successfully completed" कहकर प्रोजेक्ट के पूरा होने का अंतिम चरण बताया गया है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: 1. Fibre is extracted from coconut husks.
2. Kerala's coir industry produces eco-friendly mats and ropes.
3. Local workers gain stable employment.
4. Products are exported to various countries.
q.e: Sentence 2 introduces the primary subject, Kerala's coir industry. Sentence 1 details the core manufacturing process. Sentence 3 highlights the direct benefit of this industry to the local populace, and Sentence 4 details the global reach of the final products.

pp: (1) The wedding invitation cards were sent
(2) Guests arrived in traditional attire
(3) The venue was decorated beautifully prior to guests' arrival
(4) The ceremony began with rituals.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नोट: इस प्रश्न को SSC ने "Wrong Question" माना था। Kit के अनुसार तार्किक क्रम 1-3-2-4 है: निमंत्रण भेजे गए (1), स्थल सजाया गया (3), मेहमान आए (2), समारोह शुरू हुआ (4)। Official key भी यही क्रम 1-3-2-4 देती है।

pp: S1. Twilight was descending like a rain of gray ashes.
A. A minute later Lulu entered like a whirlwind, slamming doors, overturning chairs that she might hurry more.
B. It was the hour in which the Via Toledo becomes dangerous because of the great number of large and small carriages that pass up and down in a continuous stream.
C. Sofia, standing at the window that opened out onto the balcony, was gazing down into the crowded, noisy street.
D. Sofia seemed looking for someone; suddenly a vivid flush passed over her face, she bent her head slightly, then suddenly paled and turned back into the room.
S2. "What are you doing here, Donna Sofia Santangelo? Are you reading?"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Time-Place-Action-Interruption): S1 समय (Twilight) बताता है। B उस समय ("the hour") सड़क (Via Toledo) का हाल बताता है। C में सोफिया (Sofia) उसी सड़क (noisy street) को खिड़की से देख रही है (B-C लिंक)। D में वह किसी को देखकर अचानक घबराकर कमरे में लौट आती है। A में तुरंत बाद लुलु (Lulu) तूफ़ान की तरह अंदर आती है और S2 में सोफिया से सवाल पूछती है।

pp: 1. This led to significant breakthroughs in medicine.
2. The discovery of penicillin marked a new era.
3. It revolutionized the treatment of bacterial infections.
4. Many previously fatal diseases became curable.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Event & Sequential Impact): 2 "discovery of penicillin" (मुख्य घटना) से शुरू होता है। 3 "It" कहकर बताता है कि इसने क्या किया (इलाज में क्रांति ला दी) (2-3 का जोड़ा)। 1 "This led to" कहकर व्यापक असर (breakthroughs) बताता है। 4 इसका सबसे बड़ा अंतिम फायदा बताता है (जानलेवा बीमारियाँ ठीक होने लगीं)।

pp: A: Went on strike
B: The workers
C: After the management rejected
D: their demands
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The workers" (B) subject है, "Went on strike" (A) मुख्य verb phrase है, "After the management rejected" (C) कारण बताता है और "their demands" (D) "rejected" का object है। वाक्य बनता है: "The workers went on strike after the management rejected their demands", इसलिए सही क्रम BACD।

pp: (1) He then logged out of his user account in order to have privacy and security.
(2) He copied all his working files to the desktop so that he would not lose any work.
(3) In conclusion, he powered down the system by closing the power menu on the screen.
(4) He carefully closed down each running program and application one by one.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Computer shutdown steps): 2: फ़ाइलें desktop पर कॉपी कीं → 4: हर प्रोग्राम ध्यान से बंद किया → 1: निजता और सुरक्षा के लिए logout किया → 3: अंत में सिस्टम बंद किया। सही क्रम 2-4-1-3।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. He eventually mastered the subject.
B. He consulted multiple reference books.
C. The topic appeared extremely complex at first.
D. He practiced problems regularly.
q.e: Sentence C introduces the initial struggle (topic appeared complex). B shows his first corrective action (consulted books). D follows with his continued action (practiced problems). Finally, A provides the successful resolution (eventually mastered).

pp: Extreme drought
P. triggered migration
Q. in rural belts
R. and collapsed agriculture
S. across arid zones
q.e: The sentence starts with "Extreme drought," followed by "triggered migration" (P). This migration occurred "across arid zones" (S). The drought also "collapsed agriculture" (R), specifically "in rural belts" (Q). Thus, the sequence PSRQ creates a logically sound and grammatically correct sentence.

pp: P. He started assembling the deck planks, fastening each one in a neat, even line.
Q. He made sure that every angle was precisely square when he constructed the deck with beams and joists.
R. He prepared the foundation by excavating holes and positioning the building's columns.
S. He took a step back and admired the new outdoor area, a sturdy deck that was made to stay.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Construction Steps): निर्माण का सही क्रम: सबसे पहले नींव (foundation) तैयार की गई (R)। फिर beams और joists का ढांचा बना (Q)। उसके बाद planks जोड़े गए (P)। अंत में उसने अपने काम को निहारा (S - Conclusion)।

pp: A) by the intricate tapestry of
B) the philosopher was captivated
C) that define human existence
D) moral and ethical dilemmas
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Independent Clause & Preposition Link): वाक्य की शुरुआत एक स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य "the philosopher was captivated" (B) से होगी। 'Captivated' (मोहित होना) के बाद preposition 'by' (A) आता है (B-A लिंक)। A के अंत में 'of' है, जिसके बाद Noun "dilemmas" (D) आएगा।

pp: S1. She wished she had an hour to visit her old flat in 164th Street - just a turn around the block would be enough, but there wasn't time.
A. "The Prince of Love," she said to herself.
B. An old resentment rose against Honora, who was a born spoilsport and would spoil this trip for her if she could.
C. She walked on, getting her directions, brooding a little because she had been such a city girl once, thinking only of dress and a good time, and now she hardly knew one street from another.
D. She went into the first moving picture theatre she saw because she liked the name of it.

S2. It was about two beautiful young things, a boy with black wavy hair and a girl with curly golden hair, who loved each other and had great troubles, but it all came well in the end, and all the time it was just one fine ballroom or garden after another, and such beautiful clothes!
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Wish-Resentment-Walking-Action): S1 में वह पुराने फ्लैट जाने की इच्छा करती है। B में उसके मन में अपनी ट्रिप खराब होने को लेकर पुरानी नाराज़गी (resentment) आती है। C में वह पुरानी बातें सोचती हुई आगे बढ़ती है (walked on, brooding)। D में वह एक थिएटर (theatre) में जाती है क्योंकि उसे उसका नाम पसंद आया। A उस थिएटर याफिल्म का नाम बताता है ("The Prince of Love"), जो S2 के फिल्म की कहानी वाले वर्णन से सीधे जुड़ता है।

pp: A: The painter
B: Has completed
C: The mural
D: Beautifully
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The painter" (A) subject है, "Has completed" (B) present perfect verb है, "The mural" (C) object है और "Beautifully" (D) adverb है। वाक्य बनता है: "The painter has completed the mural beautifully", इसलिए सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: (1) He stretched for a moment and started his routine with some light morning exercise.
(2) The alarm went off on time, waking him up with a gentle ring.
(3) He looked at the time and programmed an alarm on his cell phone for precisely 6:00 a.m. the following day.
(4) Ensuring all was in position, he went to sleep early to have a good night's sleep.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Evening → Morning routine): 3: alarm लगाया → 4: सब ठीक कर सो गया → 2: अगली सुबह alarm बजा → 1: उसने अंगड़ाई ली और हल्की कसरत की। सही क्रम 3-4-2-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 11 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. spending a full day away from social media
B. after a long period of feeling overwhelmed
C. finally regain my focus and mental clarity
D. and other digital distractions enabled me to
q.e: The sentence correctly opens with the gerund phrase acting as the subject: "spending a full day away from social media" (A). This is heavily compounded by "and other digital distractions enabled me to" (D). It smoothly transitions to the infinitive result "finally regain my focus and mental clarity" (C), concluding with the temporal phrase "after a long period of feeling overwhelmed" (B).

pp: 1. This helps one to broaden one's perspective.
2. We get to meet the people there and experience their culture.
3. Traveling offers immense opportunities for personal growth.
4. It gives one an opportunity to visit different parts of the world.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General benefit → Specific → Outcome): 3: यात्रा व्यक्तिगत विकास के बड़े अवसर देती है → 4: दुनिया के अलग हिस्से देखने का मौक़ा मिलता है → 2: वहाँ के लोगों से मिलते और संस्कृति अनुभव करते हैं → 1: इससे नज़रिया व्यापक होता है। सही क्रम 3-4-2-1।

pp: A. Modern gymnastics is regulated by the Federation International de Gymnastique (FIG) which was founded in 1881.
B. Guts Muths, is known as the Grand Father of Modern Gymnastics and Friedrich Ludwig Jahn is known as the Father of Gymnastics.
C. The word gymnastics has been derived from the Greek word ‘Gymnos’meaning “naked art”.
D. In ancient Greek, the word “Gymnastics” was used to denote the exercise done with the naked body.
q.e: Sentence C starts with the etymology of the word "gymnastics." Sentence D follows by explaining its usage in ancient Greece. Sentence B introduces the key historical figures associated with the modern version of the sport. Sentence A concludes with the modern regulatory body and its founding date.

pp: 1. The Renaissance marked a revival of classical learning.
2. Artists focused on realism and human emotion.
3. Patronage from wealthy families fueled cultural output.
4. This period reshaped Europe's intellectual landscape.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Broad Subject to Summary): 1 "The Renaissance" का परिचय देता है। 2 बताता है कि इस काल में कलाकारों ने क्या किया। 3 बताता है कि इस कला को बढ़ावा कैसे मिला (अमीर परिवारों से पैसा)। 4 "This period" कहकर पूरे रेनेसां काल के प्रभाव (reshaped Europe) का सारांश देता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. The local doctor visits the village every weekend.
2. He checks blood pressure and gives advice.
3. Villagers come for consultation.
4. Children receive free vaccination.
q.e: The passage logically begins with the doctor arriving (1). Following his arrival, the villagers come to see him (3). He then proceeds to check their blood pressure (2), while the children simultaneously receive their free vaccinations (4).

pp: S1. 'In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.'
A. Christ, the special manifestation of the Absolute is known and knowable.
B. The Word has two manifestations-the general one of Nature and the special one of the great Incarnations of God: Krishna, Buddha, Jesus and Ramakrishna.
C. The Hindu calls this maya, the manifestation of God, because it is the power of God.
D. The Absolute reflecting through the universe is what we call Nature.
S2. The Absolute cannot be known: We cannot know the Father, only the Son.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Concept Definition to Specifics): S1 "The Word" का परिचय देता है। B "The Word" को दो हिस्सों (Nature और Incarnations) में बाँटता है (S1-B लिंक)। D पहले हिस्से (Nature) को 'Absolute' के परिप्रेक्ष्य में समझाता है। C बताता है कि हिन्दू इसे 'माया' (maya) कहते हैं। A दूसरे हिस्से (Incarnations/Christ) की बात करता है , जो 'known' (जिसे जाना जा सके ) है, जो S2 के "only the Son" (केवल पुत्र को जान सकते हैं) से जुड़ता है।

pp: P: Rahul
Q: completed
R: in time
S: his assignment
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही क्रम PQSR है: "Rahul completed his assignment in time." कर्ता, क्रिया, पूरक और सहायक अंश इसी क्रम में रखने पर वाक्य व्याकरण और अर्थ दोनों से सुसंगत बनता है।

pp: P. He disassembled the old engine with care, marking each component precisely.
Q. He torqued the bolts to the precise specifications, put in new gaskets, and replaced old parts.
R. After reassembling the engine, he put it back in the vehicle and reattached all of the hoses.
S. On the first turn of the key, the engine flickered to life and resumed its flawless operation.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Repair Process): इंजन मरम्मत का क्रम: सबसे पहले पुराना इंजन खोला गया (P)। फिर नए पार्ट्स डाले और बोल्ट कसे गए (Q)। उसके बाद वापस इंजन को गाड़ी में फिट किया गया (R)। अंत में चाबी घुमाते ही इंजन स्टार्ट हो गया (S - Result)।

pp: 1. Consequently, these organisms are considered the primary producers in the food chain.
2. Autotrophs are organisms that can produce their own food from inorganic substances using light or chemical energy.
3. They form the foundation of most ecosystems, providing the energy that is consumed by herbivores and, in turn, by carnivores.
4. Plants, algae, and certain bacteria are the most common examples of this type of organism.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Definition-Example-Conclusion): 2 "Autotrophs" की परिभाषा देता है। 4 "this type of organism" कहकर उनके उदाहरण (Plants, algae) देता है (2-4 का पक्का जोड़ा)। 3 "They" के ज़रिए उनका पारिस्थितिक तंत्र (ecosystems) में महत्व बताता है। 1 "Consequently" के साथ निष्कर्ष (primary producers) देता है।

pp: A: To submit
B: Asked him
C: The report
D: The manager
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The manager" (D) subject है, "Asked him" (B) verb और indirect object है, "To submit" (A) infinitive phrase है और "The report" (C) उसका object है। वाक्य बनता है: "The manager asked him to submit the report", इसलिए सही क्रम DBAC।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 15 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. Workshops and author sessions are held alongside..
2. Readers browse the latest titles.
3. The Delhi Book Fair features national and international publishers.
4. Discounted prices attract large crowds.
q.e: Sentence (3) perfectly establishes the grand event itself as the central topic. Sentence (2) describes what attendees are actively doing there. Sentence (4) intelligently explains why the crowds are so massive, and Sentence (1) lists the exciting additional side activities.

pp: (1) She started speaking as the audience settled in.
(2) The moment she stepped into the meeting room, she activated the projector.
(3) She opened the slideshow in full screen mode to have clearer visibility.
(4) She plugged her laptop into the projector with an HDMI cable.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Presentation steps): 2: कमरे में आते ही projector चालू किया → 4: HDMI से laptop जोड़ा → 3: slideshow full screen में खोला → 1: दर्शकों के बैठने पर बोलना शुरू किया। सही क्रम 2-4-3-1।

pp: A. In the beginning, focussing of the mind is difficult; therefore a beginner can start meditating for a few minutes only and later on can increase its duration.
B. All techniques of meditation involve focussing on a single point which could be breath, a mantra, a word or an object.
C. They vary in the methodology but the goal of all techniques is same, i.e., reaching an inner calm and a higher level of awareness.
D. There are several techniques of meditation.
q.e: Sentence D introduces the general topic of meditation techniques. Sentence C refers back to them with the pronoun "They", stating their common goal. Sentence B explains the fundamental process of focussing, and sentence A offers practical guidance for beginners.

pp: 1. However, it requires careful planning and execution.
2. Launching a new product can be an exciting venture.
3. Market research is the first crucial step to ensure success.
4. This helps in understanding customer needs and competitive landscape.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic-Contrast-Action-Result): 2 "Launching a new product" को रोमांचक (exciting) बताता है। 1 "However" के साथ बताता है कि रोमांचक होने के बावजूद इसमें "careful planning" चाहिए (2-1 लिंक)। 3 इस प्लानिंग का पहला कदम (Market research is the f irst...) बताता है। 4 "This helps" कहकर बताता है कि इस रिसर्च से क्या फायदा होता है (3-4 का जोड़ा)।

pp: S1. Although he was married, with children, his was a solitary disposition; he liked best to work alone.
A. Autumn was best for this, better than spring.
B. It pleased him when he was given a bank to build up or a gate to mend at the far end of the peninsula, where the sea surrounded the farmland on either side.
C. Then, at midday, he would pause and eat the pasty that his wife had baked for him and, sitting on the cliff's edge, would watch the birds.
D. In spring the birds flew inland, purposeful, intent; they knew where they were bound; the rhythm and ritual of their life brooked no delay.
S2. In autumn those that had not migrated overseas but remained to pass the winter were caught up in the same driving urge, but because migration was denied them, followed a pattern of their own.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Action to Time to Season): S1 अकेले काम करने (work alone) की पसंद बताता है। B इसका एक उदाहरण (building at far end) देता है (S1-B लिंक)। C उसके दोपहर के आराम और पक्षियों को दे खने (watch birds) की बात करता है। A बताता है कि इस काम के लिए पतझड़ (Autumn) सबसे अच्छा था। D वसंत (spring) के पक्षियों की बात करता है, जो S2 में वापस पतझड़ (autumn) के पक्षियों के विपरीत व्यवहार से जुड़ता है।

pp: 1. It is a process that involves the systematic and objective investigation of a subject to discover new facts or to confirm existing ones.
2. Research is a foundational pillar of academic and scientific progress.
3. This can be either theoretical, aiming to expand knowledge, or applied, seeking to solve a practical problem.
4. The findings of this investigation are then documented and peer-reviewed to ensure validity and credibility.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 2 "Research" को introduce करता है। 1 बताता है कि "It" एक व्यवस्थित प्रक्रिया है। 3 उसके दो प्रकार (theoretical/applied) बताता है। 4 documentation और peer-review के साथ निष्कर्ष देता है। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: 1. Oceans cover more than 70% of Earth's surface.
P: Marine species are crucial for food chains.
Q: But plastic waste threatens marine life.
R: Oceans regulate global temperature and climate.
S: They provide food and employment to millions.
6. Ocean conservation must be prioritized.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Benefits → Threat → Conservation): Sentence 1 महासागरों के विशाल फैलाव से शुरू करता है। R सबसे अहम वैश्विक लाभ (जलवायु का नियमन) बताता है। S एक और लाभ (भोजन और रोज़गार) बताता है। P समुद्री प्रजातियों की food chain में भूमिका जोड़ता है। Q plastic कचरे का विरोधाभासी ख़तरा लाता है। यह लाभ से ख़तरे तक का क्रम sentence 6 के संरक्षण आह्वान को आधार देता है। सही क्रम RSPQ।

pp: 1. Thus, despite challenges, the team managed to reach the finals.
2. The coach selected the team members based on their skills and qualities.
3. The players worked tirelessly and displayed exceptional discipline.
4. His vast experience helped him to expertly train and guide them.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Selection → Training → Effort → Result): 2: कोच ने गुणों के आधार पर खिलाड़ी चुने → 4: उसके अनुभव ने प्रशिक्षण और मार्गदर्शन में मदद की → 3: खिलाड़ियों ने अनुशासन से अथक मेहनत की → 1: इसलिए चुनौतियों के बावजूद टीम फ़ाइनल में पहुँची। सही क्रम 2-4-3-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 15 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. Customers prefer chemical-free vegetables and fruits.
2. Compost is prepared from farm waste.
3. Organic farmers in Sikkim avoid chemical fertilisers.
4. The produce is sold in organic markets.
q.e: The sequence beautifully traces the complete supply chain from production to consumer. First, farmers avoid chemicals (3). Next, they prepare natural compost (2). They then aggressively sell the produce (4), precisely because customers strongly prefer it (1).

pp: P. He presented his diagnosis and suggested a course of treatment with assurance.
Q. In order to search for particular markers, he ordered a number of imaging scans and blood tests.
R. He went over all the information, comparing it to what he knew about medicine.
S. As the patient explained their symptoms, the doctor paid close attention.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Medical Diagnosis Sequence): डॉक्टर और मरीज़ का क्रम: सबसे पहले मरीज़ ने डॉक्टर को अपने लक्षण (symptoms) बताए (S)। फिर डॉक्टर ने उसकी जाँच के लिए कुछ ब्लड टेस्ट (blood tests) लिख दिए (Q)। उसके बाद डॉक्टर ने टेस्ट की सभी रिपोर्ट (all the information) को पढ़ा (R)। अंत में डॉक्टर ने बीमारी बताई (diagnosis) और इलाज (treatment) शुरू किया (P)। S-Q-R-P सही क्रम है।

pp: (1) Many people began calling the airline's helpline for refund.
(2) The passengers waited anxiously near the boarding gate.
(3) The airline staff finally announced that the flight was cancelled.
(4) The departure time kept getting postponed.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Flight cancellation narrative): 4: उड़ान का समय बार-बार टलता रहा → 2: यात्री gate पर बेचैनी से इंतज़ार करते रहे → 3: airline ने आख़िर रद्द होने की घोषणा की → 1: कई लोग refund के लिए helpline पर फ़ोन करने लगे। सही क्रम 4→2→3→1।

pp: P. Finally, they burst crackers joyfully in the street and exchanged gifts with all their neighbours.
Q. Amita and Aman spent the afternoon carefully arranging sweets in decorative boxes for distribution.
R. As dusk fell on Diwali evening, they lit rows of earthen diyas along the courtyard and doorstep.
S. Aweek before Diwali, the entire family joined hands to clean and whitewash every room in the house.
q.e: Sentence S sets the timeline (a week before). Sentence Q follows with afternoon preparations. Sentence R describes the evening activities (dusk). Sentence P concludes with the final celebration (finally). This sequence (S-Q-R-P) provides a logical chronological flow of events during the Diwali festival.

pp: S1. Having thus laid his little plan of philosophy in his closet, Memnon put his head out of the window.
A. The one was old, and appeared quite at her ease.
B. The other was young, handsome, and seemingly much agitated: she sighed, she wept, and seemed on that account still more beautiful.
C. Our philosopher was touched, not, to be sure, with the beauty of the lady (he was too much determined not to feel any uneasiness of that kind) but with the distress which he saw her in.
D. He saw two women walking under the plane trees near his house.
S2. He came downstairs and accosted the young Ninevite in the design of consoling her with philosophy.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Look Out-Observation-Description-Reaction): S1 में मेमनॉन (Memnon) खिड़की से बाहर सिर निकालता है। D बताता है कि उसे क्या दिखा (two women) (S1-D लिंक)। A पहली औरत ("The one") का वर्णन करता है। B दूसरी औरत ("The other") का वर्णन करता है जो बहुत परेशान (agitated) थी (A-B का जोड़ा)। C में दार्शनिक उस परेशान औरत का दुःख (distress) देखकर भावुक (touched) हो जाता है , जिससे S2 में वह उसे सांत्वना (consoling) देने नीचे आता है।

pp: 1. Scientists had long theorized the existence of gravitational waves.
2. Their detection confirmed a major prediction of Einstein's theory.
3. They were eventually observed by LIGO in 2015.
4. The event opened new avenues in astrophysics.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Theory to Reality to Impact): 1 एक पुरानी 'theory' (gravitational waves) से शुरुआत करता है। 3 बताता है कि अंततः 2015 में उन्हें 'observe' कर लिया गया (1-3 लिंक)। 2 बताता है कि इस खोज (detection) ने क्या सिद्ध किया। 4 इस घटना (The event) के भविष्य पर प्रभाव को बताता है।

pp: 1. Social media influences public opinion.
P: Posts can go viral within minutes.
Q: It helps in sharing views widely.
R: However, misinformation also spreads fast.
S: This can lead to confusion or panic.
6. So, digital literacy is essential today.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Positive → Speed → Negative → Consequence): Sentence 1 सोशल मीडिया के जनमत पर प्रभाव को रखता है। Q उसका सकारात्मक कार्य (विचार व्यापक रूप से साझा करना) बताता है। P साझा करने की गति (posts मिनटों में viral) बताता है। R विरोधी नकारात्मक पक्ष (ग़लत जानकारी तेज़ी से फैलना) लाता है। S उसका नतीजा (भ्रम या घबराहट) बताता है, जो sentence 6 के digital literacy वाले आह्वान तक ले जाता है। सही क्रम QPRS।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 09 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. joke and endeavoured to smile appropriately, though
B. to say shock, remained detectable in my expression.
C. I suspect some residue of my bewilderment, not
D. Then I realized he was making some sort of
q.e: Sentence D introduces the main action ("Then I realized he was making some sort of"). It flows naturally into A ("joke and endeavoured to smile appropriately, though"). C introduces the contrast ("I suspect some residue of my bewilderment, not"), which B concludes seamlessly ("to say shock...").

pp: 1. Therefore, every child deserves the opportunity to learn.
2. Education plays a crucial role in our lives.
3. Without education, progress in society would be difficult.
4. It provides us knowledge and skills for the future.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic → Benefit → Consequence → Conclusion): 2: शिक्षा हमारे जीवन में अहम भूमिका निभाती है → 4: यह ज्ञान और कौशल देती है → 3: इसके बिना समाज की प्रगति कठिन होगी → 1: इसलिए हर बच्चे को सीखने का अवसर मिलना चाहिए। सही क्रम 2-4-3-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. the committee had
B. regarding the implementation
C. raised several objections
D. of the new policy
q.e: Standard English syntax dictates the subject ("the committee had") comes first (A). It is immediately followed by its main active verb and object ("raised several objections") (C). Then comes the prepositional phrase ("regarding the implementation") (B), completing with ("of the new policy") (D).

pp: 1. Agriculture is the backbone of our economy.
P: Farmers work hard despite unpredictable weather.
Q: They grow crops that feed the nation.
R: Yet, they face several challenges.
S: Modern technology can support better yield.
6. Ensuring farmer welfare is national duty.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic → Role → Hard work → Challenges → Solution): Sentence 1 कृषि और अर्थव्यवस्था का परिचय देता है। Q किसानों और उनकी मूल भूमिका (अन्न उगाना) बताता है। P मौसम की चुनौतियों के बावजूद उनकी कड़ी मेहनत बताता है। R विरोधाभासी हक़ीक़त (उनकी चुनौतियाँ) लाता है। S समाधान (आधुनिक तकनीक) देता है, जो sentence 6 के किसान कल्याण तक पहुँचाता है। सही क्रम QPRS।

pp: 1. Consequently, many species face extinction.
2. Climate change poses a severe threat to global biodiversity.
3. Rising temperatures and extreme weather disrupt ecosystems.
4. Urgent action is needed to mitigate its devastating effects.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Threat-Mechanism-Result): 2 "Climate change" को एक बड़े खतरे के रूप में पेश करता है। 3 बताता है कि यह खतरा कैसे काम करता है (Rising temperatures) (2-3 लिंक)। 1 "Consequently" के साथ इसका बुरा नतीजा (extinction) बताता है। 4 इसे ठीक करने के लिए तत्काल कार्रवाई (Urgent action) की माँग करता है।

pp: S1. Sofia did not raise her eyes from her work, and her slim fingers fairly flew over the delicate lace.
A. She hummed a few bars of a song and recited a verse, but Sofia appeared not to hear.
B. But Lulu wandered about the room, moving the ornaments on the shelves or opening a drawer to gaze absently into it.
C. Then Lulu, who was not blessed with too much patience, decided to put the question boldly, and, planting herself in front of her sister, she asked:
D. It was clear that she wished either to do or to say something but was abashed by her elder sister's grave manner.
S2. "Sofia, do you know what Mademoiselle Jeannette told me?"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Contrast-Reason-Attempt-Action): S1 में सोफिया ध्यान मग्न काम कर रही है। B "But" के साथ विरोधाभास देता है कि लुलु (Lulu) बैचेन होकर कमरे में घूम रही थी (S1-B लिंक)। D इस बेचैनी का कारण बताता है कि वह कुछ कहना चाहती थी पर झिझक (abashed) रही थी। A में वह अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से ध्यान खींचने (hummed) की कोशिश करती है। C में उसका धैर्य जवाब दे जाता है और वह सीधे सवाल (put the question boldly) पूछने का फैसला करती है, जो S2 में उसका सीधा सवाल है।

pp: A. Meanwhile Prince Ranjit Singh of Nawanagar who had gone to England for further studies, made a remarkable name for himself in the game of cricket.
B. He will always be remembered through the National Cricket Championship known as Ranji Trophy.
C. India entered the international arena and played its first official Test against England in 1932.
D. He is generally acknowledged as the Father of Indian Cricket although he played only in England.
q.e: The paragraph focuses on Prince Ranjit Singh. Sentence C introduces India's international debut in 1932. Sentence A provides background on Ranjit Singh's success in England. Sentence D mentions his title as the "Father of Indian Cricket." Sentence B concludes with his legacy through the Ranji Trophy.

pp: (1) She started writing her report based on the gathered information via bookmark links.
(2) She looked up information she required for her report.
(3) She bookmarked pertinent links for future reference.
(4) She had opened the laptop's browser.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Research workflow): 4: browser खोला → 2: ज़रूरी जानकारी खोजी → 3: प्रासंगिक links bookmark किए → 1: अंत में इकट्ठा जानकारी से रिपोर्ट लिखना शुरू किया। सही क्रम 4-2-3-1।

pp: P. She selected the ideal candidate for each character by casting the actors.
Q. She helped them discover their voices and goals while guiding them through the rehearsal process.
R. She collaborated with the set and lighting designers to achieve the ideal ambience.
S. She witnessed her actors realise her vision in front of an audience on opening night.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Directing Timeline): एक डायरेक्टर का काम: सबसे पहले एक्टर्स की कास्टिंग करना (P)। फिर रिहर्सल (rehearsal) करवाना (Q)। फिर सेट और लाइटिंग डिज़ाइनर्स के साथ काम करना (R)। अंत में "opening night" पर ऑडियंस के सामने परफॉरमेंस देखना (S)।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. down a car window at the critical moment.
B. Everybody agreed some intensely positive karmic energy was
C. enough to prompt a butcher to pull
D. circulating in and around Archie, the kind of thing strong
q.e: Part B sets the premise ("positive karmic energy was"). It links to D ("circulating in and around Archie, the kind of thing strong"), which connects to C ("enough to prompt a butcher to pull"). C finishes the phrasal verb in A ("down a car window...").

pp: 1. The raw footage was imported into the editing software.
2. Background music and voiceovers were synchronized.
3. Transition effects were applied between segments.
4. The final video was rendered in high resolution.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Video editing workflow): 1: कच्ची फ़ुटेज editing software में import हुई → 3: segments के बीच transition effects लगे → 2: background music और voiceover sync हुए → 4: अंतिम वीडियो render हुआ। सही क्रम 1-3-2-4।

pp: 1. Honeybees are vital for pollination.
P: They transfer pollen between flowers.
Q: This helps in the growth of fruits and seeds.
R: Without bees, many crops would fail.
S: But bee populations are declining globally.
6. Protecting bees is essential for food security.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Mechanism → Result → Consequence → Reality): Sentence 1 मधुमक्खियों और परागण का परिचय देता है। P तंत्र (फूलों के बीच पराग ले जाना) समझाता है। Q सकारात्मक नतीजा (फल और बीज की वृद्धि) बताता है। R मधुमक्खियाँ ख़त्म होने पर होने वाला परिणाम (फ़सल बर्बादी) बताता है। S घटती आबादी की चिंताजनक मौजूदा हक़ीक़त बताता है, जो sentence 6 के संरक्षण आह्वान तक सीधे ले जाती है। सही क्रम PQRS।

pp: 1. The most prevalent of these is the peer-to-peer (P2P) network, where no single entity controls the entire system.
2. Blockchain technology, at its core, is a distributed ledger that maintains a decentralized record of transactions.
3. This decentralized structure ensures security and transparency by requiring network consensus for any new record to be added.
4. It functions by distributing copies of the ledger across a vast network of computers.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun & Keyword Link): 2 "Blockchain technology" को परिभाषित करता है। 4 "It" का उपयोग करके बताता है कि यह काम कैसे करता है (distributing copies) (2-4 लिंक)। 1 इस "network" का सबसे आम तरीका (P2P) बताता है। 3 "This decentralized structure" के फायदों का निष्कर्ष देता है।

pp: S1. The church was empty and dark.
A. In perfect silence, and with his back turned towards me, he was running over the organ keys with one hand while managing the stops with the other.
B. Far away there gleamed a feeble light, like a faint star in the sky; it was the lamp burning on the high altar.
C. And the organ sounded, but in an indescribable manner.
D. By its flickering light, which only helped to make the deep horror of the shadows the more intense, I saw-I saw-Mother, do not disbelieve it-a man.

S2. It seemed as if each note were a sob smothered in the metal tube, which vibrated under the pressure of the air compressed within it and gave forth a low, almost imperceptible tone, yet exact and true.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Darkness to Light to Revelation to Sound): S1 अँधेरे चर्च (dark) का वर्णन करता है। B उस अँधेरे में एक मद्धम रोशनी (feeble light) का ज़िक्र करता है (S1-B लिंक)। D में उसी "flickering light" (रोशनी) की मदद से लेखक को एक आदमी (a man) दिखाई देता है। A बताता है कि वह आदमी क्या कर रहा था (ऑर्गन/बाजा बजा रहा था)। C बताता है कि ऑर्गन से आवाज़ आई (organ sounded), और S2 उस आवाज़ ("each note") का गहराई से वर्णन करता है।

pp: A. Every theory he proposed was dismissed as radical.
B. But centuries later, his equations solved modern problems.
C. He died penniless, never knowing his genius was real.
D. Time sometimes takes too long to apologize.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Tragedy to Redemption): A बताता है कि जीते जी उसकी हर थ्योरी (theory) खारिज कर दी गई। C इसका दुखद परिणाम है कि वह बिना मान्यता के ही मर गया (died penniless) (A-C लिंक)। B "But" के साथ बताता है कि सदियों बाद उसे सही साबित किया गया। D एक दार्शनिक निष्कर्ष (Time takes too long to apologize) देकर कहानी खत्म करता है।

pp: A. The sport of wrestling is played in different weight categories for both boys and girls.
B. The changes in weight categories are done by the Federations from time to time.
C. The weight categories are different for junior level, senior level, open championships, world championships, Olympic championships and so on.
D. The weight categories are provided to minimise the chance of injuries and also to provide an equal platform for applying strength and force for all the wrestlers.
q.e: Sentence A introduces wrestling's weight categories. Sentence D explains the primary reason and purpose for having these divisions. Sentence C elaborates on the categories across various competitive levels, and sentence B concludes with administrative updates by Federations.

pp: 1. Therefore, massive conservation efforts are required to protect it.
2. However, deforestation is a major threat to this ecosystem.
3. It is home to millions of plant and animal species.
4. The Amazon rainforest is the largest rainforest on Earth.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduction → Importance → Threat → Conclusion): 4: Amazon वर्षावन का परिचय → 3: यह करोड़ों प्रजातियों का घर है → 2: "However" से वनों की कटाई बड़ा ख़तरा है → 1: इसलिए इसकी रक्षा के लिए बड़े संरक्षण प्रयास ज़रूरी हैं। सही क्रम 4-3-2-1।

t: Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence: (A) with red flowers (B) bloomed (C) the garden (D) beautifully
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
q.e: Part C ("the garden") is the primary subject. It is followed by the verb in B ("bloomed"). A provides the prepositional modifier ("with red flowers"), and D acts as the concluding adverb ("beautifully").
