pp: A: To improve road safety
B: Stricter traffic rules
C: Should be implemented
D: Immediately
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Purpose → Adverb): "Stricter traffic rules" (B) subject है, "Should be implemented" (C) passive verb phrase है, "To improve road safety" (A) उद्देश्य बताता है और "Immediately" (D) समय का adverb है। वाक्य बनता है: "Stricter traffic rules should be implemented to improve road safety immediately", इसलिए सही क्रम BCAD।

pp: 1. Artificial intelligence is a field of computer science focused on creating machines that can simulate human cognitive functions.
2. This process is used in various applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis systems.
3. This is typically achieved by training machine learning models on vast datasets, allowing them to identify patterns and make predictions.
4. Through this training, an AI system learns to perform specific tasks, such as recognizing objects in images or translating text.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Process & Application): 1 AI की परिभाषा देता है। 3 बताता है कि यह "This" कैसे प्राप्त किया जाता है (ट्रेनिंग द्वारा)। 4 "Through this training" बताता है कि AI सिस्टम क्या सीखता है (3-4 पक्का जोड़ा)। 2 बताता है कि इस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किन एप्लिके शन्स में होता है।

pp: P. He developed his finger strength and dexterity by practicing his scales and chords daily.
Q. He studied sheet music for hours, learning to play tunes that got harder and harder.
R. He had mastered his new instrument and was now a musician.
S. He played a challenging piece perfectly from memory while performing for his buddies.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Learning to Mastery): संगीत सीखने का क्रम: पहले sheet music पढ़ी और धुनें सीखीं (Q)। फिर रोज़ प्रैक्टिस करके उँगलियों में ताक़त (finger strength) लाई (P)। फिर अपने दोस्तों (buddies) के सामने परफॉरमेंस दी (S)। और अंत में वह एक 'musician' (मास्टर) बन गया (R - Conclusion)।

pp: 1. Sensors transmitted temperature data to control servers.
2. A software patch was deployed to fix anomalies.
3. Data logs were analyzed for abnormal fluctuations.
4. Engineers isolated the source of the signal noise.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Diagnostic and repair workflow): 1: sensors ने तापमान डेटा भेजा → 3: डेटा logs में असामान्य उतार-चढ़ाव जाँचे गए → 4: इंजीनियरों ने signal noise का स्रोत अलग किया → 2: असंगतियाँ ठीक करने के लिए software patch लगाया गया। सही क्रम 1-3-4-2।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. the responsibility which ultimately lies with
B. ourselves, it has to be said that certain employers
C. have done much to encourage these sorts of trends.
D. Though we must be careful not to attempt to deny
q.e: The deeply complex sentence opens gracefully with the concessive clause: "Though we must be careful not to attempt to deny" (D) "the responsibility which ultimately lies with" (A) "ourselves, it has to be said that certain employers" (B) "have done much to encourage these sorts of trends." (C).

pp: S1. For several weeks before Christmas, my father worked after supper in the cellar of our house.
A. My brother Laird and I sat on the top step and watched.
B. The naked, slippery bodies were collected in a sack and buried in the dump.
C. My father removed the pelt inside-out from the body of the fox, which looked surprisingly small, mean, and rat-like, deprived of its arrogant weight of fur.
D. The cellar was whitewashed and lit by a hundred-watt bulb over the worktable.
S2. One time the hired man, Henry Bailey, had taken a swipe at me with this sack, saying, "Christmas present!"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Setting to Action to Conclusion): S1 तहखाने (cellar) में काम करने का ज़िक्र करता है। D उस 'cellar' का दृश्य (whitewashed, bulb) बताता है (S1-D लिंक)। A बताता है कि बच्चे सीढ़ियों पर बैठकर यह सब देख (watched) रहे थे। C पिता के काम (लोमड़ी की खाल-pelt उतारना) का मुख्य वर्णन करता है। B बचे हुए शरीर को बोरे (sack) में डालने की बात करता है, जो S2 में उसी बोरे ("this sack") से बच्चों को डराने की घटना से पक्के तौर पर जुड़ता है।

pp: 1. He co-founded Apple Inc, along with Wozniak.
2. Steve Jobs was a visionary entrepreneur and innovator.
3. His ideas continue to influence modern technology and design.
4. Apple Inc. introduced products like iPhone and iPad.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Intro → Founding → Products → Influence): Sentence 2 Steve Jobs का परिचय देता है। Sentence 1 स्थापना का संदर्भ (Wozniak के साथ Apple की सह-स्थापना) देता है। Sentence 4 Apple के प्रमुख उत्पादों को बताता है। Sentence 3 उनके स्थायी प्रभाव को बताता है। सही क्रम 2-1-4-3।

pp: 1. The most prevalent of these is the peer review process, where a manuscript is evaluated by other experts in the same field.
2. The integrity of scientific publications is upheld by a series of rigorous checks and balances.
3. The goal of this process is to validate the methodology, findings, and conclusions of the research before it is made public.
4. This external scrutiny helps to ensure that only high-quality, credible research is disseminated to the scientific community.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 2 वैज्ञानिक ईमानदारी (scientific integrity) का परिचय देने वाला topic sentence है। 1 उसे "most prevalent of these" यानी peer review तक सीमित करता है। 3 "this process" का विशेष लक्ष्य बताता है। 4 इस बाहरी जाँच (external scrutiny) का अंतिम लाभ बताकर ख़त्म करता है। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: 1. This process, a crucial part of the plant’s life cycle, is vital for the continued existence of many plant species.
2. Pollination is the transfer of pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part.
3. The transfer can be carried out by various agents, including insects, birds, and wind.
4. Successful pollination leads to fertilization and the subsequent production of seeds and fruits.
q.e: The sequence begins with sentence 2, which defines pollination. Sentence 3 explains how this transfer occurs via agents. Sentence 4 describes the biological result of the process (fertilization). Finally, sentence 1 concludes by emphasizing the vital importance of "this process" for plant survival.

pp: (1) She put the bowl under a damp cloth and let it rest in a warm corner.
(2) In a mixing bowl, she mixed the water and flour together until it was a smooth dough.
(3) She placed all the required ingredients on the kitchen counter before preparation.
(4) She kneaded the dough for a good ten minutes to make sure it was smooth and elastic.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Bread-making steps): 3: सामग्री counter पर रखी → 2: पानी और आटा मिलाकर आटा गूँथा → 4: आटे को गूँथकर मुलायम किया → 1: भीगे कपड़े के नीचे गर्म कोने में आराम के लिए रखा। सही क्रम 3-2-4-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. This imbalance affects both physical and mental health.
B. Long working hours reduce time for personal life.
C. Work-life balance is often ignored today.
D. Stress levels increase due to constant pressure.
q.e: The passage starts broadly by introducing the core societal issue: work-life balance is ignored (C). It deeply specifies exactly how it is ignored: long working hours reduce personal time (B). This inevitably causes stress levels to massively increase (D), culminating in the final health consequence (A).

pp: (1) She changed the angle and lighting in order to obtain the ideal snap.
(2) She opened her phone and scrolled through the icons to find the camera app.
(3) With a gentle touch on the screen, she took the photo successfully.
(4) Once it was opened, she kept the phone stable to see distinctly the object present in front.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Taking a photo): 2: camera app खोजकर खोला → 4: वस्तु दिखने के लिए phone स्थिर रखा → 1: सही snap के लिए कोण और रोशनी बदली → 3: फिर आराम से फ़ोटो खींची। सही क्रम 2-4-1-3।

pp: 1. Books have always been a source of knowledge.
P: They allow us to travel across time and space.
Q: We learn about different cultures and civilizations.
R: Stories in books fuel our imagination.
S: From science to art, books cover every field.
6. Therefore, reading must be encouraged in youth.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Claim → Imagination → Learning → Breadth): Sentence 1 किताबों को ज्ञान का स्रोत बताता है। P साहसिक और कल्पनाशील दावा रखता है कि वे समय और स्थान के पार ले जाती हैं। R कल्पनाशील भूमिका (कहानियाँ कल्पना को ईंधन देती हैं) बताता है। Q एक ठोस उदाहरण (संस्कृतियों और सभ्यताओं के बारे में सीखना) देता है। S शामिल विषयों की व्यापकता का सार देता है, जो sentence 6 के पढ़ने को बढ़ावा देने वाले आह्वान तक ले जाता है। सही क्रम PRQS।

pp: S1. Laurella kissed his hand, and let one farewell drop, for the padre and Antonio to divide between them.

A. But after they had turned their backs, he let his eyes travel but a short way with the padre, as he went toiling over the deep bed of small, loose stones; he soon sent them after the maiden, who, turning to the right, had begun to climb the heights.
B. At her feet lay the marina; the rugged rocks rose high around her; the sea was shining in the rarest of its deep blue splendour.
C. Just before the path disappeared behind high walls, she stopped, as if to gather breath, and looked behind her.
D. Antonio, however, appropriated no part of it to himself; he pulled off his cap exclusively to the padre, without even looking at Laurella.
S2. The scene was surely worth a moment's pause.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Reaction and Action Sequence): S1 में Laurella विदाई (farewell) देती है। D में Antonio की उस विदाई पर तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया (reaction) है कि उसने कोई हिस्सा नहीं लिया। A में बताया है कि उनके पीठ फेरने के बाद (after they had turned their backs) Antonio ने क्या किया। C में Laurella का रुककर पीछे मुड़कर देखना (looked behind) बताया गया है। B में उसके सामने फैले उस सुंदर नज़ारे (scene) का वर्णन है, जो S2 के 'The scene' से जुड़ता है (C-B का पक्का जोड़ा)।

pp: A. Faced with the high cost and scarcity of Indian indigo, European manufacturers were forced to rely on the woad plant for their dyeing needs.
B. However, cloth dyers still preferred indigo, as it produced a significantly richer and more vibrant blue than woad ever could.
C. Since woad thrived in temperate climates, it was readily available and easily cultivated throughout Europe.
D. Indian indigo was prohibitively expensive, and only meager quantities ever reached European markets.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause-Effect Logic): D में मुख्य समस्या (Indian indigo का महंगा होना) बताई गई है। D का परिणाम (effect) A में है कि इस महँगेपन के कारण उन्हें woad पर निर्भर होना पड़ा (D-A लिंक)। B में "However" लगाकर विरोधाभास बताया गया है, जो अंत में आएगा।

pp: P. She repeatedly listened to the song, taking in its passion and rhythm.
Q. She made a sequence of motions and connected them to form a smooth flow.
R. Her artistic vision was brought to the stage by the dancers, who executed the work brilliantly.
S. She taught the dance to her troupe, refining each step and making sure every moment was synchronized.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Choreography Sequence): डांस तैयार करने का क्रम: पहले गाना सुना और रिदम पकड़ी (P)। फिर डांस के मूवमेंट्स (sequence of motions) बनाए (Q)। उसके बाद अपने ग्रुप (troupe) को डांस सिखाया (S)। अंत में स्टेज पर डांसर्स ने शानदार परफॉरमेंस दी (R)।

pp: 1. Acentral tenet of this approach is the concept of a "class," which acts as a blueprint for creating objects.
2. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of "objects," which can contain data and code.
3. This allows a programmer to specify the structure and behavior of an object-oriented program.
4. The key advantage of this approach is that it models real-world entities, making complex systems easier to manage and debug.
q.e: Sentence 2 introduces the main topic (OOP). Sentence 1 follows by explaining a "central tenet" (classes) of that approach. Sentence 3 explains what this specific tenet allows the programmer to do. Finally, sentence 4 concludes by stating the overall advantage of the entire approach.

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. As a result, trust in the brand declined.
B. Customers experienced repeated defects.
C. Quality checks were ignored.
D. Sales figures dropped significantly.
q.e: Sentence C states the root cause (Quality checks ignored). B provides the immediate consequence (Customers experienced defects). A gives the secondary consequence (brand trust declined), and D concludes with the final financial impact (Sales dropped).

pp: (1) A few seconds later, the cat strolled out, looking rather proud of itself.
(2) She opened the door and called out for her missing kitten.
(3) Then came a crash from the kitchen and the sound of something shattering.
(4) Emma had been searching for her mischievous kitten all morning.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Searching → Investigating → Resolution): 4: Emma अपने बिल्ली के बच्चे को खोज रही थी → 2: उसने दरवाज़ा खोलकर आवाज़ दी → 3: तभी रसोई से धमाके की आवाज़ आई → 1: कुछ सेकंड बाद बिल्ली गर्व से बाहर निकली। सही क्रम 4-2-3-1।

pp: A: Has a long
B: India
C: And rich
D: Cultural history
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "India" (B) subject है, "Has a long" (A) verb phrase की शुरुआत है, "And rich" (C) दो adjectives को जोड़ता है और "Cultural history" (D) object है। वाक्य बनता है: "India has a long and rich cultural history", इसलिए सही क्रम BACD।

pp: 1. It is a process that involves the systematic and objective investigation of a subject to discover new facts or to confirm existing ones.
2. Research is a foundational pillar of academic and scientific progress.
3. This can be either theoretical, aiming to expand knowledge, or applied, seeking to solve a practical problem.
4. The findings of this investigation are then documented and peer-reviewed to ensure validity and credibility.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 2 "Research" को introduce करता है। 1 बताता है कि "It" क्या है। 3 उसके प्रकार बताता है। 4 documentation और peer-review बताता है। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: S1. Do you see that man with the scarlet cloak, the white plume in his hat, and the gold-embroidered vest?
A. Well, that is the Marquis of Mascoso, lover of the widow, the Countess of Villapineda.
B. They say that before he began paying court to her, he had sought the hand of a very wealthy man's daughter, but the girl's father, who they say is a trifle close-fisted-but hush!
C. Well, he is the father in question.

D. Speaking of the devil-do you see that man closely wrapped in his cloak coming on foot under the arch of San Felipet? I mean the one just getting out of his litter and going to greet that lady-the one coming along after those four pages who are carrying torches? S2. Everybody in Seville knows him on account of his immense fortune.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: S1 में स्कार्लेट लबादे वाला आदमी आता है। A तुरंत बताता है कि वह Marquis है। B उसकी पृष्ठभूमि देता है कि वह एक धनी आदमी की बेटी को रिझा रहा है, जिसका पिता कंजूस है। D "Speaking of the devil" से बीच में नए आदमी का आना बताता है। C पुष्टि करता है कि यह नया आदमी वही पिता है, जो S2 से जुड़ता है कि सब उसकी भारी दौलत के लिए उसे जानते हैं। सही क्रम ADBC।

pp: 1. He took a deep breath and walked onto the stage.
2. The audience responded with a resounding applause.
3. He delivered his speech with great enthusiasm.
4. At first, he felt nervous but then gained confidence.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नोट: Official key के अनुसार सही क्रम 1-2-4-3 है। क्रम: वह मंच पर गया (1), दर्शकों ने तालियाँ बजाईं (2), उसे घबराहट हुई पर आत्मविश्वास आया (4), उसने उत्साह से भाषण दिया (3)। तार्किक रूप से घबराहट और आत्मविश्वास भाषण से पहले आना चाहिए, फिर भी official key यही क्रम मानती है। सही क्रम 1-2-4-3।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. as I settled into a cosy corner of the local café
B. into something unforgettable
C. turning an ordinary afternoon
D. the gentle notes of live music floated through the air
q.e: The sentence beautifully begins with the introductory subordinate clause: "as I settled into a cosy corner of the local café" (A). This introduces the main action: "the gentle notes of live music floated through the air" (D), "turning an ordinary afternoon" (C) "into something unforgettable" (B).

pp: 1. The employee training program is created to improve skills.
2. Feedback is gathered after training to assess effectiveness.
3. The program is implemented and employees begin their training.
4. Adjustments are made based on the feedback collected.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (PDCA Cycle - Plan-Do-Check-Act): 1 ट्रेनिंग प्रोग्राम को 'create' (बनाया) जाता है। 3 प्रोग्राम को 'implement' (लागू) किया जाता है (1-3 लिंक)। 2 ट्रेनिंग के बाद 'Feedback' (प्रतिक्रिया) ली जाती है। 4 उस 'feedback collected' के आधार पर सुधार (Adjustments) किए जाते हैं (2-4 पक्का जोड़ा)।

pp: A: invited
B: To the event
C: Many guests
D: Were
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Place): "Many guests" (C) subject है, "Were invited" (D + A) passive verb है और "To the event" (B) गंतव्य बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "Many guests were invited to the event", इसलिए सही क्रम CDAB।

pp: The probe
P. while orbiting Mars
Q. in cosmic radiation
R. during its mission
S. encountered anomalies
q.e: The noun phrase "The probe" takes the main predicate verb in S ("encountered anomalies"). Q provides the location or nature ("in cosmic radiation"), while P and R supply the qualifying prepositional and participial clauses of time and duration.

pp: 1. The most prevalent of these is the peer review process, where a manuscript is evaluated by other experts in the same field.
2. The integrity of scientific publications is upheld by a series of rigorous checks and balances.
3. The goal of this process is to validate the methodology, findings, and conclusions of the research before it is made public.
4. This external scrutiny helps to ensure that only high-quality, credible research is disseminated to the scientific community.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 2 "checks and balances" का परिचय देने वाला topic sentence है। 1 "The most prevalent of these" यानी peer review बताता है। 3 "this process" का लक्ष्य बताता है। 4 "This external scrutiny" का अंतिम लाभ बताकर निष्कर्ष देता है। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: (1) Within a few seconds, the call went through, and her friend answered.
(2) She took up her smartphone and opened the screen with facial recognition.
(3) They talked about their weekend plans for a few minutes.
(4) She carefully dialed the number from her contacts and made the call.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Phone call steps): 2: phone उठाकर unlock किया → 4: नंबर डायल किया → 1: कॉल जुड़ी और दोस्त ने उठाया → 3: अंत में उन्होंने अपनी योजनाओं पर बात की। सही क्रम 2-4-1-3।

pp: P. The research team recruited a large group of qualified participants for the study.
Q. At the end of the trial, they analysed the results to determine the drug's effectiveness.
R. The team monitored the health and progress of all the participants for several months.
S. Half the participants received the new drug, while the other half received a placebo.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Clinical Trial Process): मेडिकल रिसर्च का क्रम: सबसे पहले रिसर्च के लिए लोगों (participants) को भर्ती किया गया (P)। फिर उन्हें दो हिस्सों (drug और placebo) में बाँटा गया (S)। फिर कई महीनों तक उनकी सेहत की निगरानी (monitored) की गई (R)। अंत में "At the end" (आख़िर में) नतीजों का विश्लेषण (analysed) किया गया (Q)।

t: Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence: (A) she was (B) known (C) for her kindness (D) in the town
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
q.e: Part D sets the location ("in the town"). Part A establishes the subject ("she was"), linking directly to the adjective/participle in B ("known"). Finally, C provides the reason ("for her kindness"). Together: "In the town, she was known for her kindness."

pp: S1. From beyond the sea came hosts of Greeks, armed for war and bent upon the conquest of the city.
A. The cry was for vengeance, and heroes and warriors from every city and town joined hands and vowed vengeance upon Troy.
B. He had stolen and carried away from her shores the most beautiful of all her women, even Helen, the wife of Menelaus of Sparta.
C. They came in a thousand little ships, with sails and oars, and landed on the beach at the foot of the plain.
D. They came because one of the princes of Troy, Paris by name, had done a grievous wrong to Greece.
S2. They built huts and tents along the shore; they kindled fires; they threw up a breastwork of earth and stones around their camp.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause & Effect Flow): S1 बताता है कि ग्रीक (Greeks) युद्ध के लिए आए। D बताता है कि वे 'क्यों' आए (प्रिंस पेरिस ने गलत किया था)। B बताता है कि उसने क्या गलत किया ('Helen' को चुराया था) (D-B लिंक)। A इस चोरी के कारण बदले (vengeance) की बात करता है। C में वे जहाज़ों से तट पर पहुँचते हैं (landed), और S2 में उसी तट (shore) पर झोपड़ियां बनाते हैं।

pp: (1) She took her prescription and departed the clinic.
(2) She consulted the doctor and explained her symptoms.
(3) She checked in at the clinic reception desk.
(4) She also patiently waited her turn in the waiting area.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Clinic visit): 3: reception पर check-in किया → 4: अपनी बारी का इंतज़ार किया → 2: डॉक्टर से मिलकर लक्षण बताए → 1: prescription लेकर क्लिनिक से निकली। सही क्रम 3-4-2-1।

pp: A: Should follow
B: Traffic rules
C: Strictly
D: Everyone
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "Everyone" (D) subject है, "Should follow" (A) verb phrase है, "Traffic rules" (B) object है और "Strictly" (C) "should follow" को modify करने वाला adverb है। वाक्य बनता है: "Everyone should follow traffic rules strictly", इसलिए सही क्रम DABC।

pp: 1. It is a process that involves the systematic and objective investigation of a subject to discover new facts or to confirm existing ones.
2. Research is a foundational pillar of academic and scientific progress.
3. This can be either theoretical, aiming to expand knowledge, or applied, seeking to solve a practical problem.
4. The findings of this investigation are then documented and peer-reviewed to ensure validity and credibility.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun Link): वाक्य 2 मुख्य Noun "Research" से विषय का परिचय देता है। वाक्य 1 में प्रयुक्त Pronoun "It" इसी Research के लिए आया है (2-1 जोड़ा)। 3 में इसके प्रकार बताए गए हैं, और 4 में अंतिम चरण (documented) बताया गया है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. constant overthinking clouds
B. simple choices into heavy burdens
C. our daily decisions transforming
D. that we rarely escape
q.e: The sentence logically opens with the dominant subject and verb: "constant overthinking clouds" (A). It acts upon "our daily decisions transforming" (C) what should be "simple choices into heavy burdens" (B) creating a trap "that we rarely escape" (D).

pp: P: He later returned to his hometown of Stratford-upon-Avon, where he died in 1616.
Q: William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon- Avon, England, in 1564.
R: During his career, he wrote thirty-seven plays and 154 sonnets.
S: In his twenties, he moved to London, joined the Globe Theatre company, and started writing professionally.
q.e: The passage outlines a biographical overview of Shakespeare. Sentence Q introduces his birth in Stratford-upon-Avon. Sentence S describes his transition to London in his twenties. Sentence P mentions his later return and demise, while sentence R summarizes his total lifetime literary output.

pp: 1. He believed in non-violent resistance.
2. Mahatma Gandhi was a key figure in India's Freedom Struggle.
3. This set an inspiring example for leaders worldwide.
4. So, he led peaceful protests against British rule.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduction → Belief → Action → Impact): 2: गांधी भारत के स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के प्रमुख व्यक्ति थे → 1: वे अहिंसक प्रतिरोध में विश्वास करते थे → 4: इसलिए उन्होंने ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध शांतिपूर्ण आंदोलन किए → 3: इसने दुनिया भर के नेताओं को प्रेरित किया। सही क्रम 2-1-4-3।

pp: S1. What a night!
A. Alas, how shall we paint the emotions that arose in her soul, that divided, tore it between love and virtue?
B. What a dreadful night for Lydia!
C. They led her to the altar as it were to punishment.

D. She adored Lausus, she detested Mezentius, she was sacrificing herself to her father's interests, delivering herself up to the object of her hatred, tearing herself forever from an adored lover. S2. Barbarous Mezentius! Thou art content to reign over the heart by violence and fear!
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Exclamation Expansion to Specifics): S1 कहता है "What a night!" B इसी बात को बढ़ाता है ("What a dreadful night for Lydia!") (S1-B लिंक)। C उस रात की डरावनी घटना बताता है (उसे वेदी-altar तक ले जाया गया)। D उस घटना के पीछे के दर्दनाक कारण (sacrificing herself) को बताता है। A उन सभी भावनाओं (emotions) का सारांश देता है, जो S2 में मेजेन्टियस (Mezentius) के प्रति गुस्से में बदल जाती हैं।

pp: A: opened
B: suddenly
C: the door
D: He
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य "He opened the door suddenly" बनता है, यानी कर्ता (D) + क्रिया (A) + कर्म (C) + क्रियाविशेषण (B) = DACB। स्रोत की key/विकल्प में DCAB छपा है, जो इस वाक्य से मेल नहीं खाता; स्रोत की त्रुटि मानें।

pp: 1. This ensures fairness and minimizes potential conflicts.
2. Conflict resolution is an essential skill in any workplace.
3. It involves active listening and seeking common ground.
4. Training in this area improves team dynamics.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun-Effect): 2 "Conflict resolution" (विवाद समाधान) को एक ज़रूरी स्किल बताता है। 3 "It involves" कहकर बताता है कि इसमें क्या शामिल है (active listening) (2-3 का जोड़ा)। 1 "This ensures" के साथ इसका तुरंत फ़ायदा बताता है। 4 'Training' (प्रशिक्षण) के बड़े लाभ के साथ समाप्त करता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 11 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. when words are insufficient
B. profound silence can communicate
C. to express the truth
D. more effectively than spoken words
q.e: The dependent clause sets the context: "when words are insufficient" (A) "to express the truth" (C). It is immediately followed by the main independent clause: "profound silence can communicate" (B) "more effectively than spoken words" (D).

pp: P. He fuelled his body for the rigorous workout by adhering to a particular diet and drinking plenty of water.
Q. He pushed his body to its limits by going on lengthy runs on the weekends.
R. Throughout the week, he increased his endurance by running shorter distances.
S. He was tired but elated when he crossed the finish line on race day.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Training Timeline): R में 'Throughout the week' (पूरे हफ्ते) की रूटीन है। Q में 'weekends' (वीकेंड) की रूटीन है (R-Q लिंक)। P इन दोनों रूटीन के लिए अपनी डाइट (diet and water) का ज़िक्र करता है। S आख़िरी रे स के दिन (race day) जीत कर खुश होने की बात करता है।

pp: 1. Millions of tourists from all over the world visit it every year.
2. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
3. The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful monuments in the world.
4. They admire it as an architectural marvel as well as a symbol of love.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduction → History → Tourism → Appreciation): 3: ताज महल एक सुंदर स्मारक है → 2: इसे शाहजहाँ ने पत्नी मुमताज़ महल की याद में बनवाया → 1: हर साल दुनिया भर से लाखों पर्यटक आते हैं → 4: वे इसे चमत्कार और प्रेम का प्रतीक मानकर सराहते हैं। सही क्रम 3-2-1-4।

pp: Regular physical activity
P. boosts mental health
Q. by reducing stress and anxiety
R. and improving sleep patterns
S. along with physical fitness
q.e: The subject "Regular physical activity" connects directly to the verb phrase in P ("boosts mental health"). S adds "along with physical fitness," while Q and R together form the adverbial clause of manner ("by reducing... and improving...").

pp: A: took care of
B: her younger brother
C: while their parents
D: were away
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य के भाग: A took care of, B her younger brother, C while their parents, D were away। स्वाभाविक वाक्य "(She) took care of her younger brother while their parents were away" ABCD बनता है; स्रोत की key BACD गलत छपी है; सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: 1. The most prevalent of these is the peer review process, where a manuscript is evaluated by other experts in the same field.
2. The integrity of scientific publications is upheld by a series of rigorous checks and balances.
3. The goal of this process is to validate the methodology, findings, and conclusions of the research before it is made public.
4. This external scrutiny helps to ensure that only high-quality, credible research is disseminated to the scientific community.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General Concept to Specific Example): 2 वैज्ञानिक प्रकाशनों में "checks and balances" का परिचय देता है। 1 इनमें से सबसे प्रचलित ("most prevalent of these") तरीका पीयर रिव्यूबताता है (2-1 लिंक)। 3 "this process" का लक्ष्य बताता है। 4 "This external scrutiny" के फायदे का निष्कर्ष देता है।

pp: (1) The teacher smiled, knowing well that the answer was written on the student's hand.
(2) Everyone turned silent as the teacher asked the unexpected question.
(3) Rahul stood up slowly, avoiding eye contact.
(4) "Rahul, can you answer that?" the teacher asked.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Classroom narrative): 2: अप्रत्याशित प्रश्न पर सब चुप हो गए → 4: शिक्षक ने ख़ास तौर पर राहुल को बुलाया → 3: राहुल नज़र चुराते हुए धीरे से खड़ा हुआ → 1: शिक्षक सब जानकर मुस्कुराए। सही क्रम 2-4-3-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 09 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. to the crowded local store
B. I unexpectedly ran out of
C. to make a late-night visit
D. essential items, which required me
q.e: Part B contains the subject and verb ("I unexpectedly ran out of"). Part D identifies what was run out of ("essential items") and introduces a relative clause. C provides the action required ("to make a late-night visit"), and A tells us exactly where the visit was directed.

pp: S1. He surveyed the way over to the terrace from which the archers had fired.
A. Going to the side of the bridge, he judged distances and how difficult it would be to reach that terrace, drew the Blades of Athena, and then leaped into space.
B. The archers had to be guarding something important.
C. That provided him as good a direction to explore as any.

D. And if he approached cautiously enough, he might find a way to declare his intentions of speaking with the Sisters of Fate so he would not have to fight his way through a phalanx of other guards. S2. The blades dug into the ornate stonework facing the palace wall.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: S1 में वह terrace का जायज़ा ले रहा है। C उस निष्कर्ष ("That") को बताता है जिससे खोज की अच्छी दिशा मिली। B उस terrace के बारे में उसका अनुमान बताता है कि वहाँ कुछ महत्वपूर्ण चीज़ की रखवाली हो रही है। D उसकी सावधानी से आगे बढ़ने की योजना बताता है। A में उसकी छलाँग आती है, जिसका सीधा नतीजा S2 में पत्थर की नक़्क़ाशी में धँसते blades हैं। सही क्रम CBDA।

pp: (1) She logged into the portal.
(2) Her connection dropped.
(3) The exam had already begun.
(4) She contacted support immediately.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Technical problem narrative): 1: उसने portal में login किया → 3: पाया कि परीक्षा शुरू हो चुकी थी → 2: फिर उसका connection टूट गया → 4: उसने तुरंत support से संपर्क किया। सही क्रम 1-3-2-4।

pp: A: The country
B: Was devastated
C: By a powerful cyclone
D: Last month
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Passive verb → Agent → Time): "The country" (A) subject है, "Was devastated" (B) passive verb है, "By a powerful cyclone" (C) कर्ता बताता है और "Last month" (D) समय बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The country was devastated by a powerful cyclone last month", इसलिए सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: 1. The final draft is prepared after multiple revisions and feedback sessions.
2. The first draft is developed and shared with the team for input.
3. Feedback is analyzed, and changes are made to improve the draft.
4. The finalized document is shared with the clients for approval.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Sequential Document Creation): सबसे पहले "first draft" (पहला ड्राफ्ट) बनेगा (2)। उस पर आई टीम की 'Feedback' का विश्लेषण कर बदलाव किए जाएं गे (3)। इसके बाद "final draft" (अंतिम ड्राफ्ट) तैयार होगा (1)। अंत में वह पूरा हो चुका "finalized document" क्लाइंट्स को भेजा जाएगा (4)।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 12 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. to the restless ocean while
B. the tide reflects the enduring silent
C. rhythm of their perpetual interaction
D. the moon appears to whisper secrets
q.e: Part D begins the poetic subject and verb ("the moon appears to whisper secrets"). It connects to A ("to the restless ocean while"). A connects to the secondary clause in B ("the tide reflects the enduring silent"), concluding with C ("rhythm of their perpetual interaction").

pp: 1. This creates a sense of belonging and support.
2. Community engagement is vital for social cohesion.
3. It involves active participation in local initiatives and events.
4. Strong communities lead to improved quality of life for all residents.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun-Result): 2 "Community engagement" (मुख्य विषय) को पेश करता है। 3 "It" कहकर बताता है कि इसमें क्या करना होता है (2-3 लिंक)। 1 "This creates" के साथ इसका मनोवैज्ञानिक फायदा (sense of belonging) बताता है। 4 एक व्यापक निष्कर्ष (Conclusion) देता है।

pp: P. Once the cycle ended, he removed all the clothes and hung them out on the drying rack.
Q. He added the measured amount of detergent, selected the appropriate wash setting, and pressed start.
R. He checked every pocket methodically for tissues, coins, or anything that could damage the machine.
S. Sachin sorted the laundry carefully into two separate piles of light-coloured and dark-coloured clothes.
q.e: The sentences describe the sequential steps of doing laundry. Sachin starts by sorting clothes into piles (S), checks pockets for harmful objects (R), adds detergent and operates the washer (Q), and finishes by hanging them out to dry (P).

pp: P. But the fleet was caught off guard as a sudden, strong storm blew in from the sea.
Q. Confident in their strategy to blockade the enemy port, the admiral gave the order for the ships to proceed.
R. The conflict became a desperate struggle for survival due to the unanticipated weather.
S. Without firing a shot, they were to cut off supplies and compel a surrender.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Plan vs Reality): Q में एडमिरल का आत्मविश्वास और आदेश है। S में उनकी योजना (strategy) है कि बिना गोली चलाये सरें डर कराएं गे (Q-S जोड़ा)। P में "But" के साथ तूफ़ान (storm) आने से योजना बिगड़ती है। R में खराब मौसम की वजह से अस्तित्व का संघर्ष (struggle for survival) बताया गया है।

pp: S1. He surveyed the way over to the terrace from which the archers had fired.
A. Going to the side of the bridge, he judged distances and how difficult it would be to reach that terrace, drew the Blades of Athena, and then leaped into space.
B. The archers had to be guarding something important.
C. That provided him as good a direction to explore as any.

D. And if he approached cautiously enough, he might find a way to declare his intentions of speaking with the Sisters of Fate so he would not have to fight his way through a phalanx of other guards. S2. The blades dug into the ornate stonework facing the palace wall.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: S1 में वह terrace का जायज़ा ले रहा है। B उसका अनुमान बताता है कि वहाँ कुछ महत्वपूर्ण चीज़ की रखवाली हो रही है। C बताता है कि इस अनुमान से खोज की अच्छी दिशा मिली। D सावधानी से आगे बढ़ने की योजना बताता है। A में छलाँग लगाने की क्रिया आती है, जिसका नतीजा S2 में पत्थर में धँसते blades हैं। सही क्रम BCDA।

pp: (1) He inserted the tray into the oven and set the timer.
(2) He served the roasted chicken with a side of vegetables.
(3) He preheated the oven to the required temperature.
(4) He placed the marinated chicken into a baking tray.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cooking steps): 3: oven को ज़रूरी तापमान पर गर्म किया → 4: चिकन को baking tray में रखा → 1: tray oven में डालकर timer लगाया → 2: भुना चिकन सब्ज़ियों के साथ परोसा। सही क्रम 3-4-1-2।

pp: A: With the help of officials
B: The villagers
C: Repaired the damaged bridge
D: Before the heavy rains
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The villagers" (B) subject है, "Repaired the damaged bridge" (C) मुख्य verb और object है, "With the help of officials" (A) साधन बताता है और "Before the heavy rains" (D) समय का संदर्भ देता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The villagers repaired the damaged bridge with the help of officials before the heavy rains", इसलिए सही क्रम BCAD।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. hallway with four opendoored rooms branching
B. storey and a garden at the end of it all.
C. Archie sidestepped Merlin and moved into a long
D. off from it, a staircase leading to another
q.e: Part C starts the action ("moved into a long") which is completed by A ("hallway with four opendoored rooms branching"). A connects to D ("off from it, a staircase leading to another") and finishes in B ("storey and a garden at the end of it all.").

pp: 1. This phenomenon is often referred to as a "network effect," where the value of a service increases with the number of its users.
2. Consequently, they tend to dominate their respective markets, leading to the creation of powerful monopolies or oligopolies.
3. The digital economy has given rise to new business models that rely on the accumulation of data and the scale of their user base.
4. A prime example is the platform economy, where companies like social media networks and ride-sharing apps create value by connecting users.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General Concept to Example): 3 नए व्यापार मॉडल का परिचय देता है। 4 इसका एक मुख्य उदाहरण (platform economy) देता है (3-4 लिंक)। 1 इस मॉडल को "network effect" का नाम देता है। 2 "Consequently" (परिणामस्वरूप) के साथ बताता है कि इससे एकाधिकार (monopolies) कैसे बनते हैं।

pp: 1. This helped her land her first job was as an assistant chef.
2. Her grandmother taught her many traditional recipes.
3. She joined a culinary school to hone her skills after college.
4. She developed an interest in cooking when she was young.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Chronological journey of a chef): 4: बचपन में खाना पकाने में रुचि जगी → 2: दादी ने पारंपरिक व्यंजन सिखाए → 3: कॉलेज के बाद culinary school में दाख़िला लिया → 1: इससे उसे assistant chef की पहली नौकरी मिली। सही क्रम 4-2-3-1।

pp: S1. In front of this building, overlooking the river, is a garden, where the once well-trimmed box borders that used to define the walks now grow wild as they list.
A. The rich vegetation of those weeds that we call foul adorns the sloping shore.
B. The wall fruit grows like hedges against the walls.
C. Several willows that spring from the Loire have grown as rapidly as the hedge that encloses it and half conceal the house.
D. Fruit trees, neglected for the last ten years, no longer yield their harvest, and their shoots form coppices.
S2. Paths once gravelled are overgrown with moss, but to tell the truth, there is no trace of a path.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Visual description Flow): S1 नदी किनारे के जंगली हो चुके बाग़ (garden) का परिचय देता है। C नदी (Loire) से उगे विलो के पेड़ों (willows) का ज़िक्र करता है। A नदी के किनारे (sloping shore) की वनस्पतियों (vegetation) की बात करता है। D neglected fruit trees (लापरवाह फलों के पेड़ों) का वर्णन करता है। B wall fruit (दीवारों वाले फलों) की बात करता है, जो S2 में बाग़ के रास्तों (Paths) के पूरी तरह गायब हो जाने से जुड़ता है।

pp: A. Lack of insulin causes increase of sugar in our body leading to the condition called diabetes mellitus.
B. Diabetes mellitus is one of the endocrine diseases.
C. Insulin regulates the level of sugar in our body.
D. It is caused due to inadequate secretion of the hormone insulin from pancreas.
q.e: Sentence B introduces the main topic, defining diabetes mellitus. Sentence D refers back to it ("It is caused due to...") explaining its origin with insulin. Sentence C describes insulin's normal function, and sentence A explains the physiological consequence of insulin deficiency.

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. aimed at
B. the government announced
C. new reforms
D. boosting economic growth
q.e: To form a logical sentence, start heavily with the primary subject and verb: "the government announced" (B). Next is the direct object: "new reforms" (C). This is followed by the modifying participle phrase: "aimed at" (A) "boosting economic growth" (D).

pp: 1. A compass is an important tool in navigation.
P: It always points towards the magnetic north.
Q: Even in cloudy weather, it shows direction.
R: It does not depend on GPS or electricity.
S: Hikers and sailors rely on it during travel.
6. Thus, it remains a reliable tool even today.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Function → Reliability → Independence → Users): Sentence 1 compass का परिचय देता है। P उसकी मूल कार्यप्रणाली (उत्तर की ओर इशारा) बताता है। Q बताता है कि ख़राब मौसम में भी वह भरोसेमंद है। R तकनीक से उसकी स्वतंत्रता (GPS की ज़रूरत नहीं) बताता है। S बताता है कि इस पर कौन निर्भर रहता है (पर्वतारोही, नाविक)। सही क्रम PQRS।

pp: 1. Therefore, it is important to conserve water.
2. Water is essential for all living beings.
3. Many regions face water shortages.
4. Rainwater harvesting is one way to save water.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Problem → Solution): 2: पानी सभी जीवों के लिए ज़रूरी है → 3: कई क्षेत्रों में पानी की कमी है → 1: इसलिए पानी बचाना ज़रूरी है → 4: वर्षा जल संचयन एक उपाय है। सही क्रम 2-3-1-4।

pp: 1. Anthropogenic climate change, driven by the emission of greenhouse gases, is causing a wide range of disruptions to global ecosystems.
2. Glacial retreat and the melting of polar ice caps have accelerated, contributing to a rise in global sea levels.
3. This has led to more frequent and intense extreme weather events, including droughts, floods, and heatwaves.
4. The collective impact of these changes poses a serious threat to human societies and biodiversity.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause & Multiple Effects): 1 मुख्य कारण (जलवायु परिवर्तन) को बताता है। 3 बताता है कि इससे ("This has led to") मौसम की घटनाएँ कैसे प्रभावित हुईं (1-3 लिंक)। 2 एक और प्रभाव (ग्लेशियर का पिघलना) जोड़ता है। 4 इन सभी बदलावों के "सामूहिक प्रभाव" (collective impact) का निष्कर्ष निकालता है।

pp: P. He started leaning big branches on a solid wood after discovering a natural hollow in the ground.
Q. He made a frame for the walls by weaving smaller branches between the major supports.
R. To provide insulation, he covered the structure with thick grass and leaf layers.
S. He was shielded from the rain and wind within the completed shelter.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Building a Shelter): शेल्टर (आश्रय) बनाने का क्रम: पहले गड्ढा ढूँढकर बड़ी लकड़ियाँ टिकाईं (P), फिर छोटी लकड़ियों से दीवार का ढांचा बनाया (Q), फिर सर्दी-गर्मी से बचने के लिए उस पर घास और पत्ते डाले (R), और आख़िर में उस "completed shelter" (तैयार आश्रय) में बारिश से बच गया (S - Conclusion)।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. attracted many
B. the bright flowers
C. colourful little butterflies
D. in the garden
q.e: The sentence logically begins with the primary active subject: "the bright flowers" (B). A spatial prepositional phrase immediately modifies it: "in the garden" (D). This is directly followed by the active verb "attracted many" (A) and the beautiful object "colourful little butterflies" (C).

pp: 1. Plants need sunlight, water and nutrients to grow.
2. So, we must take care of our plants by providing them with the right conditions.
3. Without these essential elements, plants would not survive.
4. Then, our plants will be healthy and produce flowers and fruits.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause and effect): 1: पौधों को धूप, पानी और पोषक तत्व चाहिए → 3: इनके बिना वे जीवित नहीं रहेंगे → 2: इसलिए हमें उन्हें सही परिस्थितियाँ देकर देखभाल करनी चाहिए → 4: तब वे स्वस्थ और फलदार होंगे। सही क्रम 1-3-2-4।

pp: A: My mother
B: Bought
C: A beautiful saree
D: Yesterday
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Time): "My mother" (A) subject है, "Bought" (B) verb है, "A beautiful saree" (C) object है और "Yesterday" (D) समय बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "My mother bought a beautiful saree yesterday", इसलिए सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: S1. After the repast, play is proposed.
A. A dispute arises on some circumstances in the game, and the disputants grow warm; one of his intimate friends throws a dice box at his head and strikes out one of his eyes.
B. A little play with one's intimate friends is a harmless pastime.
C. The philosopher Memnon is carried home to his house, drunk and penniless, with the loss of an eye.
D. He plays and loses all that is in his purse, and four times as much on his word.

S2. He sleeps out his debauch, and when his head has got a little clear, he sends his servant to the Receiver General of the finances of Nineveh to draw a little money to pay his debts of honour to his intimate friends.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Proposition-Generalization-Action-Consequence): S1 में खाने के बाद खेल (play) का प्रस्ताव आता है। B उस 'play' (खेल) के बारे में एक सामान्य विचार (harmless pastime) देता है। D में वह वास्तव में खेलता है (He plays) और पैसे हार जाता है। A में खेल के दौरान विवाद (dispute) होता है और एक दोस्त उसकी आँख फोड़ (strikes out eye) देता है। C में उसे घर लाया जाता है (पैसे और आँख गँवाकर), जिसके बाद वह S2 में सो जाता है।

pp: A. These are Dam (blood), Balgham (phlegm), Safra (yellow bile) and Sanda (black bile).
B. The Unani medicines are given to the person suffering from a disease to promote an equilibrium of these elements in the body.
C. Unani system of medicine is also the natural way of treatment with the help of herbal medicines.
D. According to this system, the health of a person depends on the balance of four elements in the body.
q.e: Sentence C introduces the Unani system. Sentence D explains the core principle of the system (balance of four elements). Sentence A lists those specific four elements. Sentence B concludes by explaining how medicines are used to restore that equilibrium, forming a coherent explanation.

pp: 1. This is especially useful in software development, where multiple programmers can work on the same codebase simultaneously without conflict.
2. Version control is a system that records changes to a file or set of files over time so that you can recall specific versions later.
3. The process involves a specific set of tools and commands that allow for the manipulation and tracking of changes.
4. By using version control, a project can maintain a complete history of its development, allowing for easy rollback and collaboration.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Definition & Process): 2 "Version control" को परिभाषित करता है। 3 समझाता है कि इस प्रक्रिया ("The process") में क्या शामिल है (2-3 लिंक)। 4 इसके इस्तेमाल का मुख्य फायदा (rollback and collaboration) बताता है। 1 बताता है कि यह फायदा विशेष रूप से कहाँ (software development) उपयोगी है।

pp: 1. So, everyone should be encouraged to adopt healthy eating habits.
2. A balanced diet is crucial for good health.
3. Eating the right foods can help prevent chronic diseases.
4. Healthy eating also contributes to mental well-being.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Main point → Physical benefit → Mental benefit → Call to action): 2: संतुलित आहार अच्छी सेहत के लिए अहम है → 3: सही भोजन पुरानी बीमारियों से बचाता है → 4: यह मानसिक कल्याण में भी योगदान देता है → 1: इसलिए सबको स्वस्थ खान-पान की आदतें अपनाने के लिए प्रेरित करना चाहिए। सही क्रम 2-3-4-1।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 12 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. brought back many warm memories of
B. long summer afternoons
C. re-reading my favourite childhood story
D. spent in the quiet garden
q.e: The gerund phrase "re-reading my favourite childhood story" (C) beautifully functions as the massive subject. It pairs flawlessly with the active verb phrase "brought back many warm memories of" (A) "long summer afternoons" (B) "spent in the quiet garden" (D).

pp: 1. Exercise keeps the body fit and active.
P: It also boosts mental health.
Q: Regular workouts reduce stress levels.
R: Walking, cycling, and yoga are easy options.
S: Physical activity strengthens the heart and muscles.
6. So, exercise should be part of our routine.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Physical → Mental → Examples): Sentence 1 कसरत को शरीर के लिए फ़ायदेमंद बताता है। S शारीरिक फ़ायदे (हृदय और मांसपेशियाँ) बताता है। Q मनोवैज्ञानिक फ़ायदा (तनाव घटना) लाता है। P "also boosts" से मानसिक सेहत पर और विस्तार करता है। R चलने और योग जैसे व्यावहारिक उदाहरण देता है, जो sentence 6 के कसरत को आदत बनाने वाले आह्वान तक ले जाता है। सही क्रम SQPR।

pp: 1. Employees receive a performance review at the end of each quarter.
2. Based on performance, goals are set for the next quarter.
3. Feedback is provided during the review session.
4. The employees then work towards meeting the set targets.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Sequential Process): यह कॉर्पोरे ट काम का एक सीधा क्रम है। सबसे पहले 'performance review' होता है (1)। उस 'review' के दौरान 'Feedback' दिया जाता है (1-3 लिंक)। फिर उस परफॉरमेंस के आधार पर नए 'goals' (लक्ष्य) तय किए जाते हैं (2)। "then" (फिर) के साथ वाक्य 4 में एम्प्लॉइज उन 'targets' पर काम करना शुरू करते हैं।

pp: 1. Augmented reality (AR) enhances user interaction by overlaying digital elements onto the physical world.
2. It has applications in gaming, education, and training.
3. AR uses devices like smartphones and AR glasses to deliver experiences.
4. However, widespread adoption is limited due to the cost of AR hardware.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Definition-Mechanism-Contrast): 1 "Augmented reality (AR)" को परिभाषित करता है। 3 बताता है कि AR कैसे काम करता है (devices के ज़रिए) (1-3 लिंक)। 2 "It" के ज़रिए इसके उपयोग (applications) बताता है। 4 "However" के साथ इसकी चुनौती (hardware cost) को पेश करता है।

pp: P. In search of the queen bee, he cautiously opened the beehive and examined the frames.
Q. He took out a honey frame and scraped off the wax covers with a knife.
R. He put the frame in an extractor, which used centrifugal force to spin the honey out.
S. As a delightful reward for his labour, he filled jars with the delicious, fresh honey.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Honey Extraction Process): मधुमक्खी के छत्ते से शहद निकालने का क्रम: सबसे पहले छत्ता खोला (P), फिर एक फ्रेम निकाला और वैक्स हटाया (Q), फिर उसे एक्सट्रैक्टर मशीन में डालकर शहद निकाला (R), और अंत में शहद को जार (jars) में भर लिया (S - Reward)।

pp: S1. Then, one day, she was up, playing; Isabel was in the kitchen fixing lunch for the two boys when they'd come in from school, and she heard Grace fall down in the living room.
A. And she ran to the living room and there was little Grace on the floor, all twisted up, and the reason she hadn't screamed was that she couldn't get her breath.
B. When you have a lot of children you don't always start running when one of them falls, unless they start screaming or something.
C. Yet, Isabel says that when she heard that thump and then that silence, something happened in her to make her afraid.
D. And, this time, Grace was quiet.
S2. And when she did scream, it was the worst sound, Isabel says, that she'd ever heard in all her life, and she still hears it sometimes in her dreams.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Action-Contrast-Fear-Reaction): S1 ग्रेस (Grace) के गिरने की आवाज़ (fall down) की बात करता है। B सामान्य बात बताता है कि बच्चे के गिरने पर माता-पिता तुरंत नहीं दौड़ते, जब तक वो रोए नहीं। D एक विरोधाभास देता है कि इस बार "Grace was quiet" (ग्रेस शांत थी) (B-D लिंक)। C इस सन्नाटे (silence) के कारण पैदा हुए डर (afraid) को बताता है। A डर के कारण माँ का दौड़कर जाना (ran to living room) बताता है, जिसके बाद S2 में आख़िरकार ग्रेस के चीखने (scream) की भयानक आवाज़ का ज़िक्र है।

pp: 1. Thomas Edison was a great inventor.
2. This invention changed the way people lived.
3. He invented numerous devices.
4. Perhaps, the most important was the electric bulb.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduce → General → Specific → Impact): 1: Edison महान आविष्कारक थे → 3: उन्होंने कई उपकरण बनाए → 4: शायद सबसे महत्वपूर्ण बिजली का बल्ब था → 2: इस आविष्कार ने लोगों के जीने का तरीक़ा बदल दिया। सही क्रम 1-3-4-2।

pp: Antarctica to (A) / scientists study (B) / past and future (C) / understand Earth's (D)
q.e: The sentence follows a logical subject-verb-object structure. "Scientists study" (B) is the subject and verb. They study "Antarctica to" (A) "understand Earth's" (D) "past and future" (C). Thus, the sequence B-A-D-C forms the coherent sentence: "Scientists study Antarctica to understand Earth's past and future."

t: Arrange the sentence parts: (A) for her success (B) congratulated (C) they (D) the candidate
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
q.e: Part C ("they") provides the subject pronoun. B ("congratulated") acts as the transitive verb. D ("the candidate") is the direct object receiving the congratulations, and A ("for her success") explains the reason.

pp: The update
P. ensuring security
Q. enhanced encryption
R. and data autonomy
S. across user devices
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Verb → Object 1 → Object 2 → Result → Scope): वाक्य बनता है: "The update enhanced encryption (Q) and data autonomy (R), ensuring security (P) across user devices (S)." Q (verb + पहला object) + R (दूसरा object) + P (present participle वाला नतीजा) + S (दायरा) सबसे स्वाभाविक वाक्य बनाता है। सही क्रम QRPS।

pp: 1. The document is scanned to extract text using OCR software.
2. Original pages are uploaded in image format.
3. Errors in the scanned text are corrected manually.
4. The output is saved in a searchable PDF format.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Digitisation workflow): 2: मूल पन्ने image के रूप में upload हुए → 1: OCR software से text निकालने के लिए स्कैन हुआ → 3: स्कैन किए text की ग़लतियाँ हाथ से सुधारी गईं → 4: आउटपुट searchable PDF के रूप में सहेजा गया। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: 1. The most critical component is the central processing unit (CPU), which acts as the "brain" of the machine.
2. The architecture of a modern computer is a complex arrangement of various hardware and software components.
3. This complex interplay of components allows the computer to execute a wide range of tasks, from simple calculations to complex simulations.
4. The CPU works in tandem with memory, storage devices, and input/output peripherals to process data.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General to Specific): 2 कंप्यूटर के आर्किटेक्चर (general topic) का परिचय देता है। 1 उसमें से सबसे ख़ास हिस्से (CPU - specific component) की बात करता है (2-1 लिंक)। 4 बताता है कि CPU बाकी हिस्सों के साथ कैसे काम करता है। 3 "This complex interplay" कहकर इन सबके एक साथ काम करने का नतीजा बताता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 11 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. baggage like physical luggage
B. through every day
C. we often carry heavy emotional
D. dragging our weary souls
q.e: Start the sentence logically with the main subject and verb: "we often carry heavy emotional" (C). This is seamlessly modified by the simile "baggage like physical luggage" (A). Follow up with the participle phrase describing the result: "dragging our weary souls" (D) "through every day" (B).

pp: S1. Down in the dust though my spirit was, I might have tried to strike him for those words if at that moment I had not noticed something very surprising.
A. When, therefore, Mr. Preston gave me the coat which he had picked up from the floor, I saw with terror that my own was already hanging on my arm and that the two were alike in every way.
B. My coat had cost more money than most men could spend, and it had been made especially for me.
C. I remembered that the strange being who had so mysteriously entered and left the room had had a coat.
D. It was different, I thought, from every other coat in the world. S2. No one else in the group had been wearing one.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Surprise Context & Climax): S1 किसी बहुत ही चौंकाने वाली बात (something very surprising) का माहौल बनाता है। C उस 'surprising' बात की शुरुआत करता है कि उस अजनबी इंसान के पास भी एक कोट (coat) था। D लेखक के अपने कोट के बारे में है ("It was different... from every other coat")। B बताता है कि वह कोट इतना अलग क्यों था (cost more money... made especially for me)। A में क्लाइमेक्स है—उसे फर्श से उठाकर जो कोट दिया गया वो बिल्कुल उसके अपने कोट जैसा (alike) था जबकि उसका कोट तो उसके हाथ पर ही था, जो S2 के निष्कर्ष ("No one else... wearing one") से जुड़ता है।

pp: (1) He started driving.
(2) He selected the fastest route.
(3) He opened the map application.
(4) He entered his destination.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Navigation app steps): 3: map application खोला → 4: गंतव्य डाला → 2: सबसे तेज़ रास्ता चुना → 1: फिर गाड़ी चलाना शुरू किया। सही क्रम 3-4-2-1।

pp: A. The examples of this consistency can be seen in a person who remains friendly or a person who is generally kind or helpful in most situations.
B. It tells us what type of person one is.
C. Personality is a very common term which is used in our day-to-day life.
D. We know that each person generally behaves consistently in most of the situations.
q.e: Sentence C introduces the broad concept of "personality." Sentence B explains the function of personality (telling us the type of person). Sentence D introduces the concept of behavioral consistency. Sentence A provides specific examples of the consistency mentioned in the previous sentence, completing the logical flow.

pp: P. She gracefully finished with her arms up after landing flawlessly on both feet.
Q. She flipped and twisted her body in midair as she blasted herself off the springboard.
R. She ran briskly in the direction of the vault to start her routine.
S. With a faultless performance and a perfect score, she bowed to the judges and the audience.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Gymnastics Sequence): जिमनास्टिक्स का क्रम: सबसे पहले छलांग लगाने के लिए दौड़ना (R)। फिर स्प्रिंगबोर्ड से हवा में उछलना और फ्लिप करना (Q)। उसके बाद पैरों के बल सही से लैंड करना (P)। अंत में जजों और ऑडियंस को झुककर अभिवादन (bow) करना (S)।

pp: 1. The shift to renewable energy sources is essential for the future of our planet.
2. Solar and wind energy are among the most promising alternatives to fossil fuels.
3. Governments must invest in renewable energy infrastructure.
4. Energy storage solutions are critical to ensuring a stable energy supply.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General to Specific Example): 1 'renewable energy' की आवश्यकता बताता है। 2 इसके विशिष्ट उदाहरण (Solar and wind) देता है (1-2 लिंक)। 4 इनकी एक तकनीकी आवश्यकता (Energy storage) बताता है। 3 सरकारों से इसमें निवेश करने की अपील (Conclusion) करता है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. to disturb him, seized his telephone and had almost
B. He dashed back across the road, hurried up to
C. finished dialing his home number when he changed his mind.
D. his office, snapped at his secretary not
q.e: Start directly with the incredibly fast-paced action: "He dashed back across the road, hurried up to" (B) "his office, snapped at his secretary not" (D) "to disturb him, seized his telephone and had almost" (A) "finished dialing his home number when he changed his mind." (C).

pp: 1. The raw data was first compiled from field reports.
2. Charts and graphs were generated for visual clarity.
3. The data was then filtered for inconsistencies.
4. A final summary was submitted to the board.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Data analysis workflow): 1: कच्चा डेटा पहले field reports से संकलित हुआ → 3: फिर असंगतियों के लिए छाँटा गया → 2: फिर स्पष्टता के लिए charts और graphs बने → 4: अंत में board को सारांश सौंपा गया। सही क्रम 1-3-2-4।

pp: S1. Two days and two nights did Peter sleep without once awakening.
A. He looked; there were two bags of gold.

B. When he came to himself, on the third day, he looked long at all the corners of his hut but in vain did he endeavour to recollect what had taken place; his memory was like a miser's pocket from which you cannot entice a quarter of a kopek.
C. Stretching himself, he heard something clash at his feet.
D. Then only, as if in a dream, he recollected that he had been seeking for treasure and that something had frightened him in the woods.
S2. But at what price he had obtained it, and how, he could by no means tell.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Awakening-Action-Discovery-Memory): S1 बताता है कि पीटर (Peter) दो दिन और दो रात सोया। B तीसरे दिन (third day) उसके जागने और याददाश्त खोने की बात करता है (S1-B लिंक)। C में वह अंगड़ाई लेता है (Stretching himself) और पैरों के पास एक आवाज़ (clash) सुनता है। A में वह देखता है तो उसे सोने के दो थैले (two bags of gold) मिलते हैं। D में सोना देखकर उसे धुंधला सा याद आता है कि वह खजाना (treasure) ढूंढने गया था। S2 कहता है कि उसे यह याद नहीं कि उसने इसकी क्या कीमत (what price) चुकाई।

pp: A: His advice
B: The students
C: Accepted
D: Happily
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Object → Adverb): "The students" (B) subject है, "Accepted" (C) मुख्य verb है, "His advice" (A) object है और "Happily" (D) बताता है कि कैसे स्वीकार किया। वाक्य बनता है: "The students accepted his advice happily", इसलिए सही क्रम BCAD।

pp: 1. Its vibrant ecosystems support unique flora and fauna.
2. The Amazon rainforest is a global treasure.
3. Deforestation, however, poses a significant threat to its survival.
4. Protecting it is vital for global biodiversity.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Noun-Pronoun-Threat): 2 "Amazon rainforest" विषय को स्थापित करता है। 1 "Its" कहकर अमेज़न की खूबियां (ecosystems) बताता है (2-1 लिंक)। 3 "however" लगाकर इस खजाने पर मंडराते खतरे (Deforestation) को बताता है। 4 इसे बचाने (Protecting it) की अपील कर समाप्त करता है।

pp: P: several schools / Q: participated / R: across Delhi / S: in the awareness drive
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नोट: इस प्रश्न को SSC ने "Wrong Question" माना था। सबसे स्वाभाविक वाक्य होता है: "Several schools across Delhi participated in the awareness drive"। Kit के अनुसार PQSR ज़्यादा स्वाभाविक होता, जबकि दिए गए क्रम PRSQ में वाक्य थोड़ा अटपटा बनता है। Official key के अनुसार सही क्रम PRSQ माना गया है।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 15 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: 1. The Republic Day parade is held in Delhi.
2. The President unfurls the national flag.
3. Students from many states participate.
4. The parade is watched by thousands of people.
q.e: The passage gracefully follows chronological and thematic order. It first introduces the grand main event (1), proceeds immediately to the primary formal action (2), highly describes the active participants (3), and finally highlights the massive audience response (4).

pp: 1. within its ice cores (A)
2. carbon records (B)
3. Antarctica holds (C)
4. half-million-year-old (D)
q.e: The sentence begins with the subject and verb "Antarctica holds" (C). It is followed by the object "half-million-year-old" (D) "carbon records" (B). Finally, the prepositional phrase "within its ice cores" (A) provides the location. The correct logical sequence is C-D-B-A.

pp: A: After the meeting
B: The team members
C: Went
D: To a restaurant
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Time phrase first): "After the meeting" (A) समय बताने वाला शुरुआती phrase है, "The team members" (B) subject है, "Went" (C) verb है और "To a restaurant" (D) गंतव्य है। बनता है: "After the meeting, the team members went to a restaurant"। अंग्रेज़ी में समय वाले phrase से शुरू करना स्वाभाविक है। सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: (1) He locked the door and stepped out to start his journey.
(2) He arrived at the top just in time to view the sunrise.
(3) He laced up his boots and loaded up his backpack with essentials.
(4) He traced the marked path along the forest.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Hike narrative): 3: जूतों के फीते बाँधे और बैग पैक किया → 1: दरवाज़ा बंद कर यात्रा पर निकला → 4: जंगल के चिह्नित रास्ते पर चला → 2: सूर्योदय के ठीक समय शिखर पर पहुँचा। सही क्रम 3-1-4-2।

pp: S1. I was an outsider, and, as I had no special matters to air, I was able to spend the evening independently of the others.
A. He was tall, rather thin, very serious, and well dressed.
B. He was the first to attract my attention.
C. There was another gentleman present who like myself had just stumbled upon this affair of domestic bliss.
D. His appearance was not that of a man of birth or high family. S2. Apparently he had no heart for the family festivities.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Self-Intro-Other Intro-Attention-Description): S1 नैरेटर को एक 'outsider' (बाहरी) के रूप में पेश करता है। C एक और व्यक्ति ("another gentleman") का परिचय देता है जो नैरेटर की तरह ही था (S1-C लिंक)। B बताता है कि इसी व्यक्ति ने सबसे पहले उसका ध्यान (attention) खींचा। D उसके बाहरी रूप (appearance) के बारे में एक सामान्य बात कहता है। A उसके रूप का विशिष्ट वर्णन (tall, thin, serious) करता है, जिसकी "seriousness" S2 में उसे उत्सवों (festivities) से दूर रखती है।

pp: P. He created mockups of each screen the user would view in order to build the user interface.
Q. He programmed the app's features and response, writing the fundamental logic.
R. He fixed errors and made sure the app ran well by testing it on a variety of devices.
S. He made the finished product available for download by uploading it to the app store.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (App Development Sequence): ऐप बनाने का क्रम: पहले स्क्रीन की डिज़ाइन (mockups) बनाई (P)। फिर कोडिंग करके उसके फीचर बनाए (Q)। फिर अलग-अलग डिवाइस पर उसे टेस्ट किया और एरर फिक्स किए (R)। अंत में तैयार ऐप (finished product) को 'app store' पर डाल दिया (S)।

pp: 1. Solar energy is one of the most promising renewable energy sources.
2. It has a minimal environmental impact compared to fossil fuels.
3. Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
4. However, energy storage remains a significant challenge for solar energy systems.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic-Mechanism-Benefit-Challenge): 1 विषय (Solar energy) का परिचय देता है। 3 इसकी कार्यप्रणाली (mechanism) बताता है। 2 इसका फायदा ("minimal environmental impact") बताता है। 4 "However" के साथ इसकी एक चुनौती (challenge) को सामने रखता है जो अंत में आएगा।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 11 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: A. or anticipation at all.
B. say I was seized by any excitement
C. For the first twenty minutes or
D. so of motoring, I cannot
q.e: Part C ("For the first twenty minutes or") connects seamlessly to D ("so of motoring, I cannot"). D then links to the verb in B ("say I was seized by any excitement"), which completes its thought in A ("or anticipation at all.").

pp: A. The rules were clear, but the loopholes clearer.
B. Compliance meant obedience; strategy meant survival.
C. He chose the latter without regret.
D. And the system applauded him for it.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Premise-Dilemma-Choice-Result): A स्थिति बताता है (नियम और कमियां)। B दो विकल्प (Compliance vs Strategy) देता है। C "He chose the latter" (उसने बाद वाला चुना - यानि Strategy) कहकर चुनाव बताता है (B-C का पक्का जोड़ा)। D उस चुनाव का परिणाम (system applauded) बताता है।

pp: 1. The police investigated the matter thoroughly.
2. A robbery took place in the local bank.
3. They gathered evidence from the crime scene.
4. Eventually, the culprits were caught and arrested.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Crime narrative): 2: स्थानीय बैंक में डकैती हुई → 1: पुलिस ने मामले की गहन जाँच की → 3: उन्होंने घटनास्थल से सबूत जुटाए → 4: आख़िरकार दोषी पकड़े गए। सही क्रम 2-1-3-4।

pp: P. though he lacked international experience
Q. was selected for the Olympic squad
R. the young shooter
S. due to his exceptional performance at the national trials
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Reason → Concession): "The young shooter" (R) subject है और "was selected for the Olympic squad" (Q) verb phrase है। "Due to his exceptional performance at the national trials" (S) कारण बताता है। "Though he lacked international experience" (P) विरोधी (concessive) clause है। सही क्रम RQSP।

pp: few seconds on (A) / spans only a (B) / the geological clock (C) / human civilisation (D)
q.e: The sentence should start with the subject "human civilisation" (D). The verb "spans only a" (B) follows to describe the duration. Then, "few seconds on" (A) provides the specific timeframe, and "the geological clock" (C) completes the comparison. Thus, the logical order is DBAC.

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 12 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. in our profession, whatever
B. There existed in those
C. the small differences in our approach,
D. days a true camaraderie
q.e: Standard syntax dictates opening with the existential phrase: "There existed in those" (B) "days a true camaraderie" (D). This introduces the setting: "in our profession, whatever" (A) "the small differences in our approach" (C).

pp: A. Here, the picture-perfect French Quarter and heritage-laden Tamil streets blend into one another.
B. Across many metropolitan cities, there exists a visible conflict in how the old and the new coexist.
C. The old and new, like two different worlds, surviving side by side yet never crossing that chasm.
D. However, Puducherry stands as a striking exception, where these very contrasts are celebrated rather than endured.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (General to Specific & Contrast): B शहरों में पुराने और नए के बीच टकराव की एक सामान्य बात (General statement) करता है। D में "However" लगाकर Puducherry को इस बात का एक अपवाद (exception) बताया गया है (B-D लिंक)। A में "Here" का प्रयोग Puducherry के लिए हुआ है, इसलिए D के बाद A आएगा।

pp: S1. It was a blazing hot day in August.
A. For myself, my term of service in India had trained me to stand heat better than cold, and a thermometer at ninety was no hardship.
B. Our blinds were half drawn, and Holmes lay curled upon the sofa, reading and re-reading a letter which he had received by the morning post.
C. Baker Street was like an oven, and the glare of the sunlight upon the yellow brickwork of the house across the road was painful to the eye.
D. It was hard to believe that these were the same walls which loomed so gloomily through the fogs of winter.
S2. But the morning paper was uninteresting.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Outside to Inside Description): S1 गर्मी (hot day) का परिचय देता है। C "Baker Street" की बाहर की भीषण गर्मी (like an oven) बताता है। D सर्दियों के कोहरे (fogs of winter) से इन दीवारों की तुलना करता है। B घर के अंदर के माहौल (blinds drawn) की बात करता है। A में नैरेटर कहता है कि उसे भारत में रहने के कारण यह गर्मी सहने की आदत है, और वह अखबार पढ़ने लगता है जो S2 के उबाऊ 'morning paper' से जुड़ता है।

pp: (1) The sky turned dark with thick, black clouds.
(2) People rushed to take shelter under nearby shops and trees.
(3) A loud clap of thunder followed by heavy rainfall startled everyone.
(4) The wind began to blow strongly, scattering leaves and dust.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Storm narrative): 1: आसमान घने काले बादलों से अँधेरा हुआ → 4: तेज़ हवा चलने लगी → 3: बादल की गड़गड़ाहट के साथ तेज़ बारिश ने सबको चौंकाया → 2: लोग पास की दुकानों और पेड़ों के नीचे भागे। सही क्रम 1→4→3→2।

pp: A: The guests
B: Arrived
C: At the party
D: Early
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Subject → Verb → Adverb → Place): "The guests" (A) subject है, "Arrived" (B) verb है, "Early" (D) verb को modify करने वाला adverb है और "At the party" (C) जगह बताता है। वाक्य बनता है: "The guests arrived early at the party", इसलिए सही क्रम ABDC।

pp: P. She presented the findings to her team, revealing new patterns in the business.
Q. She created a series of functions to clean and transform the data, making it usable.
R. She developed a dashboard to visualise the insights and trends hidden in the data.
S. She wrote a script to extract raw data from multiple sources.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Data Analytics Workflow): डेटा साइंस का काम: सबसे पहले अलग-अलग जगह से Raw Data निकाला (S)। फिर उस डेटा को साफ़ (clean) करके काम का बनाया (Q)। उसके बाद उस डेटा को देखने के लिए डैशबोर्ड (dashboard) बनाया (R)। अंत में उन नतीजों (findings) को अपनी टीम के सामने पेश किया (P)।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 15 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
pp: 1. Clouds gathered over the village.
2. The weather forecast predicted rainfall.
3. Farmers prepared their fields for sowing.
4. Soon, there was a heavy shower.
q.e: A chronological progression of cause and effect: Sentence 2 provides the initial forecast. Relying on this, Sentence 3 shows the farmers preparing. Sentence 1 demonstrates the physical signs of the incoming weather, leading to the actual result in Sentence 4 (the heavy shower).

pp: 1. The sun provides us heat and light.
2. Plants, the primary producers, need sunlight to survive.
3. Therefore, without the sun, life on Earth would not exist.
4. It is also the primary source of energy on Earth.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Introduce → Role → Dependency → Conclusion): 1: सूर्य हमें गर्मी और रोशनी देता है → 4: यह प्राथमिक ऊर्जा स्रोत भी है → 2: पौधों को जीवित रहने के लिए धूप चाहिए → 3: इसलिए सूर्य के बिना पृथ्वी पर जीवन नहीं होगा। सही क्रम 1-4-2-3।

pp: 1. Virtual reality simulates immersive environments.
2. It is used in therapy, training, and gaming.
3. VR headsets track motion and adjust visual output.
4. Rapid tech advancement is reducing hardware costs
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Definition-Mechanism-Application): 1 "Virtual reality" का परिचय देता है। 3 बताता है कि यह काम कैसे करता है (VR headsets track motion) (1-3 लिंक)। 2 "It" के ज़रिए इसके इस्तेमाल (therapy, gaming) बताता है। 4 हार्डवेयर की कम होती कीमतों के बारे में एक अतिरिक्त जानकारी देकर समाप्त करता है।

pp: P. Early on Christmas morning, the excited children rushed downstairs to unwrap the gifts under the tree.
Q. On Christmas Eve, the whole family attended a candlelit carol service at their local church together.
R. After the service, they returned home, warmed up with hot cocoa, and tucked in the children for the night.
S. Throughout December, the family decorated the home with lights, tinsel, and a tall Christmas tree.
q.e: Sentence S sets the initial timeline ("Throughout December"). Sentence Q follows chronologically with Christmas Eve activities. Sentence R details what happened immediately after the church service on Christmas Eve, and Sentence P concludes the sequence on Christmas morning.

t: Choose the correct option
pp: S1. He saw a most wonderful sight.
A. In every tree that he could see there was a little child.
B. The birds were flying about and twittering with delight, and the flowers were looking up through the green grass and laughing.
C. And the trees were so glad to have the children back again that they had covered themselves with blossoms and were waving their arms gently above the children's heads.
D. Through a little hole in the wall the children had crept in, and they were sitting in the branches of the trees.
S2. It was a lovely scene, only in one corner it was still winter.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Cause-Sight-Reaction): S1 एक अद्भुत नज़ारे (wonderful sight) की बात करता है। D बताता है कि बच्चे दीवार के छे द से अंदर आ गए थे और पेड़ों पर बैठे थे (यह वह नज़ारा था)। A में वह नज़ारे का विवरण देता है—हर पेड़ पर एक बच्चा (child in every tree) (D-A लिंक)। C में पेड़ों की ख़ुशी (trees were so glad) बताई गई है। B में पक्षियों और फूलों (birds and flowers) की ख़ुशी है, जो S2 के 'lovely scene' (प्यारे दृश्य) से जुड़ता है।

pp: 1. They are formed by tiny animals called coral polyps.
2. Coral reefs are home to many marine species.
3. This is caused by rising ocean temperatures and pollution.
4. Corals are losing their wonderful colours due to coral bleaching.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Topic → Biology → Crisis → Cause): Sentence 2 कोरल रीफ़ को समुद्री प्रजातियों का आवास बताकर शुरू करता है। Sentence 1 बताता है कि वे coral polyps से बनती हैं। Sentence 4 आधुनिक संकट (coral bleaching से रंग उड़ना) लाता है। Sentence 3 उस bleaching का कारण (बढ़ता तापमान और प्रदूषण) बताता है। सही क्रम 2-1-4-3।

pp: (1) She finally found her keys under the sofa.
(2) Sarah searched frantically for her missing keys.
(3) Relieved, she rushed out the door.
(4) She was already late for her appointment.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Problem → Pressure → Resolution → Action): 2: Sarah बेचैनी से अपनी खोई चाबियाँ खोज रही थी → 4: वह अपनी appointment के लिए पहले ही देर से थी → 1: आख़िर चाबियाँ सोफ़े के नीचे मिलीं → 3: राहत के साथ वह दरवाज़े से बाहर भागी। सही क्रम 2→4→1→3।

q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 09 sep 2026, Shift-1]
pp: A. kid had an unnerving way of emphasizing certain words
B. shoulder to the left.
C. Archie noted the
D. by moving his head in a wide circular movement from the right
q.e: The main independent clause sets the immediate scene: "Archie noted the" (C) "kid had an unnerving way of emphasizing certain words" (A). The participial phrase beautifully elaborates how: "by moving his head in a wide circular movement from the right" (D) "shoulder to the left." (B).

pp: 1. The blueprint is finalized after approval from stakeholders.
2. First, a basic framework is proposed.
3. Then revisions are made after discussions.
4. Finally, execution begins as per plan.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick: 2 शुरुआती प्रस्ताव ("First") से क्रम शुरू करता है। 3 चर्चा और संशोधन बताता है जो कालक्रम में अगला चरण है। 1 औपचारिक मंज़ूरी दिखाता है। 4 अंतिम क्रियान्वयन के साथ पूरी प्रक्रिया ख़त्म करता है। सही क्रम 2-3-1-4।

pp: 1. Suddenly, her car started making a strange noise.
2. She immediately pulled over to the side of the road.
3. After a few minutes, the engine stopped working completely.
4. Laura sang as she drove to work.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Trick (Car trouble narrative): 4: Laura गाड़ी चलाते हुए गा रही थी → 1: अचानक कार से अजीब आवाज़ आई → 2: उसने तुरंत गाड़ी किनारे रोकी → 3: कुछ मिनट बाद इंजन पूरी तरह बंद हो गया। सही क्रम 4-1-2-3।

pp: A. Hence, consumption of excessive salt in daily food, packaged and canned foods need to be avoided.
B. Use of excess salt is linked with hypertension.
C. If you are in the habit of adding table salt to your food you are consuming excess salt.
D. All packaged and canned food items contain a very high level of sodium because of the presence of salt that is used as a preservative.
q.e: Sentence D introduces the source of high sodium (packaged foods). Sentence C discusses the habit of adding salt. Sentence B links excess salt to hypertension. Sentence A provides the concluding advice (Hence...) to avoid such foods, creating a logical flow from cause to consequence.

pp: A: I have never
B: Seen such
C: A huge gathering
D: Before today
